## 3. CONFIRMED novel findings (ranked by statistical strength)

### Tier A — anchor-class (< 10⁻¹⁵ or unique classical ratification)

1. **Bismillah = 19 letters, 4 words, abjad 786** — locked anchor, used as calibration for all downstream work. (methodology.md §8)

2. **muqaṭṭaʿāt density effect χ² = 228.78, p < 10⁻¹⁵** — the 14 disjoined letters opening 29 surahs show enrichment in their host surahs beyond 3-gram Markov null. Stouffer Z = +4.48. Three independent null models. **Forward cross-ref ([[h-new-24-b1-b2-orthogonalization|H-NEW-24]] letter-multiset, 2026-04-13):** the letter-distribution axis is richer than the muqaṭṭaʿāt finding alone — [[h-new-24-b1-b2-orthogonalization|H-NEW-24]] detects **41 of 113 interior surah boundaries** by letter-multiset JS-divergence scanning at z = +4.39 under sub-e within-surah shuffle null (length confound decisively ruled out, letter-ordering contribution NEGATIVE — real ordering suppresses boundary signal relative to shuffled). Quran surahs have per-surah letter-multiset signatures detectable at massive-corpus scale. [[h-new-24-b1-b2-orthogonalization|H-NEW-24]] is tokenization-free and rule-robust; complements the muqaṭṭaʿāt enrichment finding by showing letter-distribution structure extends beyond the 29 opened surahs to the whole 114. (findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-24-b1-b2-orthogonalization.md; side-finding [[h-new-24-b1-b2-orthogonalization|h-new-24]]-letter-ordering-suppression.md) (findings/phase-b-hypotheses/muqattaat-density-audit.md)

3. **Hapax legomena at verse-endings p = 7.35 × 10⁻²⁹, OR = 3.19** — strongest statistical signal in the project. **Strengthened 2026-04-13 by within-verse slot-control test (team-discovery-020 H-NEW-23):** 395 root hapaxes, observed verse-final 121, expected under uniform-within-verse 53.95 ± 6.32, **2.24× excess at z = +10.61, p ≈ 0**. The rareness-bias confound is now empirically refuted — hapaxes are ACTIVELY placed at verse-final, not passively drifting there. **al-Zarkashī's *al-maqṣūda li-ghayrihā* mechanism (*al-Burhān* nawʿ 59 §4) empirically confirmed at corpus scale.** Plus: eschatological-genre hapax rate 7.71% vs legal-genre 0.20% — **38× ratio**, chi² = 113.96, p ≈ 0. Converges with H-NEW-19 Ibn Abī l-Iṣbaʿ elision-eschatology finding and al-Suyūṭī *Itqān* nawʿ 65 into a **triple-test classical cluster** confirming eschatological-slot engineering. **Forward cross-ref (T-004 Muʿallaqāt positive-control, 2026-04-13):** the mechanism is **partially register-wide classical Arabic** — Muʿallaqāt pooled show hapax-final enrichment at z = +6.43, p = 6.1 × 10⁻¹¹ (monorhyme qaṣīda rhyme-slot engineering IS a real phenomenon), but **the Quran's signature is ~2× stronger** (z = +10.61 vs z = +6.43, two-sample z-diff +6.67, p = 2.5 × 10⁻¹¹). 5 of 7 odes show positive z; Labīd reverses. Finding: the slot-mechanism is a classical-Arabic rhyme-tradition feature whose Quranic instance is discriminatively more concentrated than the pre-Islamic qaṣīda baseline. NOT a Quran-unique invention, but NOT a neutral null either — a genre-level effect strengthened in the Quran. (findings/phase-b-hypotheses/t004-muallaqat-hapax-slot-positive-control.md) (findings/phase-b-hypotheses/hapax-legomena.md, findings/phase-b-hypotheses/hapax-slot-mechanism.md)

4. **Ism al-Aʿẓam composite p ≈ 5 × 10⁻¹⁸** — top-10 computational ranking matches classical ḥadīth shortlist. **Forward cross-ref (item #5 H-META-1, 2026-04-14):** this finding is the canonical example of the M-5 classical-doctrine-decomposition pattern — a structural-formal ranking over 10 axes vindicates the classical ḥadīth tradition (Tirmidhī 3478, Ibn Mājah 3856) qualitatively, while simultaneously refuting the numerological wing of the same tradition (no Ism = digit-root-9, no abjad-sum regularity, ḥisāb al-jummal extensions fail). H-META-1 provides the ex-ante quantitative grounding — this composite is in the classical-balāgha lane (72% base confirmation rate) not the modern-numerology lane (0% confirmation rate). (findings/phase-b-hypotheses/ism-azam-composite-test.md)

5. **H-META-1 confirmable-claim signature classifier PASS at p ≈ 0 (LR L1 78.2% CV, Tree d=3 70.1% CV; Bonferroni k=2 at α=0.025)** — **meta-finding about the project's finding distribution**, not a finding on-text. Claim-side features alone (era, school, claim-type, substance-type, broad-ḥisāb indicator, specificity) predict empirical verdict CONFIRMED/REFUTED at 78.2% mean 5-fold CV accuracy under 500× label-permutation null (null mean 0.6419, null 97.5 %ile 0.6419, empirical p = 0.0000). Depth-3 tree replicates at 70.1% CV (null 0.5851, p = 0.0040). N = 120 claims (77 CONFIRMED + 43 REFUTED). You can predict at ~78% accuracy whether a Quranic structural claim will survive empirical audit **without looking at the Quran**. **Headline empirical finding — classical balāgha/munāsabāt tradition is ~7× more reliable than modern iʿjāz ʿilmī/numerology (legacy ~7× point estimate; CI-refined central estimate 13× per item #5a, see below):** structural-formal claims confirm at 72% (53/74), semantic at 67% (18/27), numerical-gematric at **32% (6/19)** — a >2× gap at substance-type level. broad-ḥisāb-al-jummal generic-divisibility claims confirm at 32% (6/19) vs non-ḥisāb 70% (71/101). Per-era: classical-medieval 77%, contemporary-academic 71%, modern-apologetic **0% (0/7)**, modern-numerology **0% (0/10)**. The legacy ~7× point estimate is preserved here as honest-trail discipline (Flag B leave-as-annotated, team-lead 2026-04-14); the CI-refined replacement sits at **item #5a (Beta-binomial Jeffreys posterior, Track B median 13.3× [3.5×, 138.7×], five sensitivity tracks preserving median ≥ 5×)**. Downstream citations of the classical/modern ratio should use #5a, not the ~7× figure above. **Forward cross-ref (item #5c honest-distribution scorecard, 2026-04-14):** the #5a 13× central ratio with sensitivity-robust lower bound ≥ 5× is the scorecard's single strongest positive-finding row; full 95 % CI and five sensitivity tracks at item #5a below and consolidated into the scorecard at item #5c. Per-claim-type: word-count-symmetry 81%, rhetorical-figure 75%, letter-count 71%, structural 62%, divisibility-miracle 25%, scientific-foreknowledge **0% (0/6)**. **After L1 lasso (λ=0.05), only 3 of 47 features retain non-zero weight:** `school=modern` (w = −1.158, strongly predicts REFUTED; 19/20 refuted), `specificity` (w = +0.172), `era=classical-medieval` (w = +0.075). Most variance lives on a single axis: modern-apologetic/numerology vs classical/project. **Classical-tradition implication:** al-Zarkashī, al-Suyūṭī, al-Biqāʿī, Ibn ʿĀshūr, al-Jurjānī, al-Rummānī, Ibn Abī l-Iṣbaʿ, al-Kirmānī — empirically more reliable than modern iʿjāz ʿilmī / ḥisāb al-jummal traditions by a large margin, not as methodological artefact (identical protocols applied to both registers) but as substantive finding about what *kind* of structural claim the Quran actually sustains. Classical claims describe surface-observable rhetorical/compositional patterns (rhyme, inclusio, taṣdīr, munāsaba, mutashābih pairing, pericope-topic coherence) the text objectively exhibits; modern-numerology claims posit hidden arithmetic structures that fail null-model testing (H-NEW-34 abjad-residue null, H-NEW-15 clean-factorization null, H-NEW-22 acrostic null). **M-5 "classical-doctrine decomposition pattern" quantitative validation:** what M-5 asserts qualitatively (classical doctrines decompose into passing structural-compositional sub-claims + failing numerological sub-claims) is now numerically confirmed — classical-tradition reliability has a detectable ex-ante signature. **Guidance artifact for triage:** new claims from modern-numerology / iʿjāz ʿilmī lane flagged for extra scrutiny; classical balāgha / munāsabāt lane flagged as high-prior-CONFIRMED. Limits: N=120 modest; L1 λ=0.05 aggressive (collapses to 3 features); claim selection biased toward project's tested corpus (77 structural / 43 numerological-plus-other); "modern" school lumps apologetic + numerology; LLM-judge deeper version unrun. Honesty disclosures: no post-hoc feature selection, no threshold tuning; λ_LR=0.05, n_iter=200, tree depth=3 all pre-specified; B reduced from 1000 to 500 perms for compute budget (p-resolution 0.002 adequate at α=0.025). Rules tuple: meta-level — operates on claim metadata, not on Quran text directly (inherits locked tuple from underlying 120 claims). Seed 20260413. Cross-references: M-5 Path F classical-doctrine decomposition (now quantitatively grounded); M-6 pericope-substrate memo (H-META-1 supports — structural-formal-at-pericope confirms, letter-arithmetic refutes); H-META-2 null-model-comparator (complementary — H-META-2 asks "is our null model calibrated?", H-META-1 asks "is the claim itself predictable?"); dual disconfirmation of ḥisāb al-jummal extensions (cross-ref X-4 T4 item #30 same-direction finding at verse-constraint scale). **Forward cross-ref (item #5b MW-6 triangulation, 2026-04-14):** the Option A retrain (#132) added MW-6 verbatim-confidence tier as a 5-level one-hot feature and produced delta = +0.0000 — H-META-1 is at the ceiling of its current feature set; the MW-6 moderator signal is fully absorbed by `substance_type` and `specificity`. The MW-6 protocol's value-prop is testability prediction, not reliability-feature loading. See item #5b for the triangulated meta-finding. **Tier-A placement rationale:** while an on-text finding at 78% CV is typically Tier-B, H-META-1 is a **meta-classifier about the project's finding distribution** — a unique anchor-class type distinct from in-text statistical findings. It quantitatively grounds the project's entire classical-vs-modern reliability claim, and serves as standing guidance for future audit triage. Task #28 (original H-META-1 execution). (findings/phase-c-structures/confirmable-signature-meta.md; corpus findings/phase-c-structures/h-meta-1-corpus-120.tsv; script scripts/h_meta_1_classifier.py)

5a. **Classical-modern reliability ratio with credible intervals — second Tier-A meta-finding of the classical/modern triangulation (categorical leg, 2026-04-14 peel-out from item #5 embedded prose)**. Beta-binomial Jeffreys posterior refinement of the project's legacy ~7× point estimate for the ratio of confirmable rates between classical-medieval and modern numerology/apologetic claims about the Quran. Three definitional tracks, each with full posterior under Beta(c+0.5, n−c+0.5) Jeffreys prior (non-informative, reparameterization-invariant, resolves the c=0 pathology that collapses MLE-based estimators in the 1-confirmed-of-20-broad-modern data regime): (A) **named-vs-named 4.82×**, (B) **named-vs-broad 13.27× (recommended primary)**, (C) **all-vs-broad 13.35×**. Track B 95% CrI **[3.53×, 138.69×]**, 90% CrI [4.17, 86.15]; **P(ratio ≥ 5) = 0.909**, **P(ratio ≥ 10) = 0.634**, P(ratio ≥ 20) = 0.332. **Five sensitivity analyses all preserve median ≥ 5×:** (S1) drop top-2 contributors al-Suyūṭī + al-Zarkashī — median 13.09× (barely moves, not driven by either scholar); (S2) restrict to canonical-4 Suyūṭī/Zarkashī/Biqāʿī/Rāzī — median 11.45× (al-Biqāʿī macro-ring failures dilute the canonical pool but comfortably above legacy ~7×); (S3) brutal selection-bias correction halving classical CONFIRMED count — median 10.74× (ratio robust to aggressive "half of classical confirms are selection-bias artifacts" assumption); (S4) hypothetical +1 modern CONFIRMED — median 7.48× (models "what if Khalifa or Al-Kaheel were partly right after all?"); (S5) hypothetical +2 modern CONFIRMED — median 5.39× (the weakest sensitivity point still above 5×). Robustness profile: the median is more sensitive to modern-denominator increases (S4, S5) than classical-numerator decreases (S1, S2, S3). **Where the legacy ~7× figure sits in the Track B posterior:** 7× = 20.6th percentile (data assign ~79% posterior mass to ratio ≥ 7), 10× = 36.9th percentile, **13× = 50th percentile (the median)**, 15× = 55.4th percentile, 20× = 66.7th percentile. The legacy figure was on the conservative low end, not a central estimate — item #5a's 13× supersedes it as the load-bearing central estimate for downstream citation. **Recommended canonical form for citation:** *"classical-medieval claims confirm at ~13× the rate of modern numerology/apologetic claims (Beta-binomial Jeffreys posterior median 13.27×, 95% CrI [3.5×, 138.7×], sensitivity-robust lower bound ≥ 5× across five analyses, #5a / task #127)"*. **Method caveats (six listed in source §7, non-skip):** (1) **selection bias unresolved** — the 0.778 classical numerator is conditional on the H-META-1 corpus which was constructed with testability awareness; the reported ratio is an upper bound on the true population ratio; S3 halved-haircut still yields ≥10×; (2) **modern-lane denominator sparsity** — 19 of 20 broad-modern rows are REFUTED with Neuwirth/Wild as the lone CONFIRMED; wide upper CrI bound (138×) reflects honest uncertainty about the true modern rate, not methodology failure; (3) **independence assumption violated** — tests share corpora, baselines, methods; Beta-binomial posterior assumes Bernoulli independence; the true CI is wider than reported; treat as lower bound on uncertainty; (4) **ratio is a comparative summary, not a fundamental constant** — depends on corpus composition, not a discovery about the texts themselves; (5) **ratio framing risks misinterpretation** — always report both absolute rates alongside the ratio (classical ~0.78, modern ~0.05); (6) **MW-6 verbatim-confidence not used as a moderator in #127** — that follow-up was executed as #129 and landed at item #5b. **Three-leg meta-theory placement:** #5a is the **categorical leg** ("modern fails ~13× more often than classical") between item #5 (discriminative leg — H-META-1 classifier 78.2% CV predicting *which* claims survive) and item #5b (within-classical refinement leg — MW-6 moderator inversion + Option A retrain zero-lift). #5/#5a/#5b reads as a visually parallel three-leg meta-theory; #5c is the external-reader synthesis index (1-1-1-4 honest distribution). **Tier-A placement rationale:** like #5 and #5b, this is a meta-finding about the project's finding distribution — a *corpus-level summary statistic about classical-vs-modern reliability*, not an on-text finding. It consolidates the 120-claim H-META-1 corpus into a single load-bearing ratio with honest CI width, which downstream work cites when comparing classical-medieval vs modern-numerology reliability. The peel-out from item #5 embedded prose into its own anchor (2026-04-14, team-lead approval via meta-analyst relay) reflects the ratio's standalone Tier-A substance (Beta-binomial method, 95% CrI, five sensitivity tracks, six method caveats, recommended canonical citation form) that warrants its own anchor rather than remaining buried in H-META-1 §1 prose. Task #127 (CI refinement), #144 (peel-out filing). (findings/cross-finding/classical-modern-reliability-ratio.md; script scripts/classical_modern_reliability_ratio.py; underlying corpus findings/phase-c-structures/h-meta-1-corpus-120.tsv; per-scholar tables findings/cross-finding/scholar-convergence-tracker.md)

5b. **MW-6 verbatim-confidence tier predicts CLAIM TESTABILITY, not RELIABILITY — third Tier-A meta-finding of the classical/modern triangulation (paired #129 + #132, 2026-04-14)**. **Forward cross-ref (item #5c honest-distribution scorecard, 2026-04-14):** this MW-6-inversion + Option A zero-lift pair is the "1 surprising inversion of pre-test hypothesis + 1 clean negative" row of the seven-deliverable honest-distribution scorecard's 1-1-1-4 summary — see item #5c for the full 7-deliverable synthesis. **Forward cross-ref (item #5a classical-modern reliability ratio, 2026-04-14):** item #5b is the within-classical refinement leg of the three-leg meta-theory whose categorical leg is #5a (classical-medieval claims confirm at ~13× the modern-numerology rate under Beta-binomial Jeffreys posterior). The MW-6 moderator inversion in #5b shows that *even within the classical-medieval 78% hit-rate subset quantified at #5a*, VERIFIED-tier cannot be used to further stratify reliability — item #5a's 13× is the corpus-level summary, item #5b refines *which dimension of classical provenance* does and does not predict reliability (school/substance-type DO, verbatim-verification tier DOES NOT). Two paired empirical results that triangulate the H-META-1 (item #5) and classical-modern reliability ratio (item #5a) story at the within-classical refinement layer. **Headline:** the MW-6 protocol's value-prop is *testability + provenance*, not *reliability*. It predicts WHICH classical claims can be cleanly tested with high-confidence verbatim citations, not WHICH claims will pass the test once they are run. **Empirical leg 1 — moderator inversion (#129):** Restricted to classical-medieval era (n = 62) to avoid era × tier confound. VERIFIED-tier classical claims have a confirmable rate of 0.618 [0.384, 0.827], *lower* than SECONDARY-tier at 0.829 [0.696, 0.929]. Cross-tier ratio VERIFIED/SECONDARY = 0.748 [0.457, 1.047], **P(VERIFIED > SECONDARY in confirmable rate) = 0.048** under Beta-binomial Jeffreys posterior Beta(c+0.5, n−c+0.5), n_iter = 20000. Posterior ordering by mean: PENDING (0.916) > SECONDARY-TRIANGULATED (0.834) > SECONDARY (0.829) > VERIFIED (0.618) > UNTAGGED (0.165). Ordering is **non-monotone in tier** — ordinal encoding of MW-6 would have been a misspecification. **Mechanism (per S3 sensitivity analysis):** VERIFIED tier is over-populated with structural-formal claims that have harder pass-bars at the operationalization stage. Verbatim-confidence rigor selects for *substantively committed* claims (specific, numerically pinned, structurally unambiguous), and substantively committed claims fail more often than vague-paraphrase claims do. Reframe the protocol's value-prop: testability + provenance, not reliability. **Empirical leg 2 — Option A H-META-1 retrain (#132) BOOKKEEPING-ONLY:** Adding `mw6_tier` as a 5-level one-hot feature to the H-META-1 classifier changes LR L1 5-fold cross-validated accuracy by **exactly +0.0000 (4 decimal places, baseline = retrained = 0.7820)**. All 5 MW-6 tier one-hot coefficients zero out under L1 penalty in the full-data model. Tree d=3 baseline drops 0.0084 (0.7010 → 0.6926) — disclosed as not pre-registered, well within fold-to-fold noise; both runs still PASS at α=0.025 against permutation null. Pre-registered decision-matrix cell BOOKKEEPING-ONLY (P1 lift ≥ +0.01 = MISS, P2 mw6=VERIFIED full-data coef negative = MISS-zero) — the cleanest possible negative result, six-cell decision matrix locked before the run. **Triangulation reading:** the moderator signal is **real at the corpus-conditional rate level** (Beta-binomial posterior P = 0.048) but **collinear with `substance_type` and `school=modern`** at the classifier feature level. MW-6 protocol value lives at audit / verification / Bonferroni layers, not as a classifier-loaded feature. Triangulated finding is healthier than either leg alone: rate-level reality + classifier-level absorption = MW-6 is procedural hygiene, *not* a hidden reliability axis the H-META-1 classifier was missing. **Paired with items #5 + #5a, the three Tier-A meta-findings form the project's first coherent meta-theory of which classical claims hold up and why:** (a) **discriminative** — H-META-1 78.2% CV claim-side classifier (item #5) confirms "what kind of claim" predicts "whether it passes"; (b) **categorical (item #5a)** — classical-medieval scholars confirm at ~13× [3.5×, 138.7×] the rate of modern numerology/apologetics under Beta-binomial Jeffreys posterior (Track B median 13.27×, sensitivity-robust lower bound ≥ 5× across five analyses) — confirms *era* is a strong moderator; (c) **within-classical refinement (this item #5b)** — even within classical-medieval, the VERIFIED-tier inversion shows that the verification protocol predicts *testability* not *reliability*, and the H-META-1 classifier already absorbs the substantive signal. Each surprising on its own; together coherent. **First methodological warning the project derived from a within-corpus statistical test rather than a single-paper red flag** is M-9 (§6 item 9); this item #5b is the **first within-classical Tier-A refinement the project derived from pre-registered moderator + classifier-feature triangulation** — a paired-empirical-leg meta-result class new to the §1 inventory. **Tag-discipline note:** this is a §1 Tier-A meta-finding (statistical-evidence-aggregation surface), not an MW-N protocol entry. The MW-6 protocol document itself lives at §6b MW-6 (formalized 2026-04-14, classical-scholar lane); item #5b is about the *empirical evidence regarding the protocol*, not the protocol document. The §6b MW-6 entry continues to govern operational citation discipline; item #5b governs the *interpretation* of what MW-6 tagging means for downstream Bonferroni / classifier accounting. **Pre-registration discipline:** Option A six-cell decision matrix locked in `findings/cross-finding/h-meta-1-mw6-prereg.md` *before* the run; encoding choice (one-hot, 5 levels) explicitly logged in the pre-reg garden-of-forking-paths section; team-lead approved post-run as the strictly more general spec given the data is non-monotone in tier; no post-hoc feature selection or threshold tuning. **Source:** findings/phase-b-hypotheses/classical-quantitative-claims-audit.md. 90 discrete testable numerical claims mined from 12 pre-modern sources (9th-17th c. CE). **Verdict: 49 CONFIRMED (54%), 18 PARTIAL (20%), 18 CONTRADICTED (20%), 5 UNDERDETERMINED (6%).**

#### Other exact confirmations

- **Al-Dānī's 8 per-surah verse counts all match** across 950 years (al-Dānī d. 444/1052 recorded specific counts that we verified token-for-token).
- **7 of 8 al-Suyūṭī hapax claims exact.**
- **al-Rāzī's "14 of 28 muqaṭṭaʿāt letters = half the alphabet" claim is EXACT.**
- **Refrain counts:** Ar-Raḥmān 31 *fa-bi-ayyi ālāʾi*; Al-Mursalāt 10 *waylun yawmaʾidhin*; Al-Ṣāffāt 5 *salām* salutations.
- **al-Kirmānī's ~1,100 *mutashābih* pairs** matches the project's detector at **1,085 pairs**.

### NOVEL exact-count discoveries (unprecedented)

- **The full Shahāda phrase *lā ilāha illā Allāh* appears EXACTLY 2 TIMES** in the Quran: **Q 37:35 and Q 47:19**. Remarkable for the faith's foundational creed — it's stated in the Quran just twice.
- **Ikhwān al-Ṣafāʾ's 903 abjad sum** of the 14 muqaṭṭaʿāt letters was initially flagged as wrong under mashriqī (which gives 693), but is **EXACT under the maghribī abjad table** (ص=60, س=300). Rule-tuple discipline rehabilitated the 10th-century Ismāʿīlī claim.

### Classical claims CONTRADICTED (honest reporting)

- **Classical letter-frequency rank-order *alif > lām > mīm* is FACTUALLY WRONG.** Correct rank-order under locked rules: **ا > ل > ن > م** (nūn, not mīm, is third). This is a ~1,100-year-old error that the computational audit corrects.
- **"All muqaṭṭaʿāt surahs are Meccan"** — FALSE. Three Medinan exceptions.

## 3d. STAGED findings (pending audit migration)

**Standing subsection (created 2026-04-14, team-lead Option A approval).** §3d is the permanent staging bay for findings that have NOT yet passed skeptical-auditor review, parallel to §3b (classical-quantitative audit-cleared) and §3c (team-discovery audit-cleared).

### Scope

- Autonomous-wake-agent findings (not team-discovery lineage, no generator→scholar→tester→auditor→integrator flow).
- Independent-agent findings routed outside the team cycle.
- Team-discovery findings flagged for §3d pending auditor ruling on a specific leg rather than the whole deliverable.
- Any finding where placement authority is preserved but audit-dependency discipline is maintained — lands in §3d now, migrates on auditor clear.

### Migration protocol

Upon skeptical-auditor ruling on a §3d entry:

| Auditor ruling | Destination |
|---|---|
| PASS, team-discovery lineage | migrate to **§3c** |
| PASS, classical-quantitative lineage | migrate to **§3b** |
| REFUTED (any lineage) | migrate to **§4 REFUTATIONS** |
| MECHANISM-INCONSISTENT / escalation | held in §3d with escalation-memo cross-reference; auditor issues second ruling after escalation resolves |
| PARTIAL (some legs PASS, some REFUTED) | split: PASSING legs migrate per lineage rule, REFUTED legs migrate to §4, §3d retains nothing |

The auditor's ruling determines destination. §3d is not a parking lot — it is a holding bay with explicit TTL (migration on audit).

### PENDING-RETEST sub-class (new 2026-04-14, first instance H-NEW-1)

A second, distinct gate-class within §3d: findings whose verdict is held not because an auditor has not yet ruled, but because the **null model itself is under retest** and the original z-statistics are flagged as not-reliable until a calibrated null is identified. PENDING-RETEST entries differ from auditor-pending entries in three ways:

1. **Gating event is a meta-test verdict, not an auditor ruling.** PENDING-RETEST entries cite an upstream H-META-N or H-NEW-META-N dependency by task ID + current status. The dependency is what unblocks them.
2. **Revert-condition is pre-locked in the entry.** Whereas auditor-pending entries delegate destination to the auditor's PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL ruling, PENDING-RETEST entries pre-state what the destination is for each meta-test outcome. The integrator then mechanically applies the pre-locked rule on meta-test landing.
3. **Sibling-flag protocol.** A PENDING-RETEST entry must enumerate any sibling findings that share the same null-model dependency, so that when the meta-test lands, all affected findings are processed together rather than re-discovered one at a time.

| Meta-test outcome | Destination (PENDING-RETEST sub-class) |
|---|---|
| Calibrated null identified, primary signal survives | migrate back to **§3c** with corrected z-statistics + descriptive trail |
| Calibrated null identified, primary signal fails | migrate to **§4 REFUTATIONS** with explicit reverse-from-§3c trail and descriptive-pattern footnote |
| No calibrated null available (META-NULL-REINFORCED) | finding remains in §3d-PENDING-RETEST permanently or is downgraded to "descriptive pattern preserved, magnitude claims withdrawn" per pre-locked revert-condition |

**Why a separate sub-class.** Auditor-pending and meta-test-pending look superficially similar (both are §3d holding bays) but differ in epistemic structure: auditor-pending is awaiting *human judgment* on a settled result; meta-test-pending is awaiting *empirical resolution* of the test's own validity. Conflating the two would let meta-test failures masquerade as auditor delays. The sub-class makes the gate type explicit and prevents the confusion.

**First instance (and pattern reference).** H-NEW-1 verse-ending consonant Markov-residual surprise, gated on H-NEW-META-3 (#118). See H-NEW-1 entry below.

#### R-011 — Tomorrow-Test T5 persistent-homology of verse-embedding manifold NULL

Self-refuting honesty: the Quran's own self-description motivated the pre-registered prediction; the test's inability to detect it is publishable.
- **Baseline composition:** 4 matched corpora, tashkeel-stripped, sentence-chunked at mean-verse-char-length=65, deterministic seed 20260413. Bukhari-noquran (Quran-quote-stripped hadith matn, 6,236 sampled units), Sīrat Ibn Hishām (6,236 units), Jāḥiẓ *Kitāb al-Ḥayawān* (6,236 units), Muʿallaqāt 7-ode pool (770 units exhausted). All subsampled to n=2,000 for V-R per pre-registered subsample fork (full 6,236 triggered OOM at ~120 GB estimate).
- **H0 secondary fingerprint (flagged non-pre-registered):** Quran H0 total-lifespan = 882.60, lowest of five corpora. Verses cluster tighter than Jāḥiẓ (1,433.49) — cluster-geometry observation consistent-with-but-weaker-than al-Biqāʿī's *waḥdat al-mawḍūʿ* (thematic unity). **Explicitly not counted toward Tomorrow-Tests verdict. Cannot rescue T5 from NULL.**
- **What R-011 does NOT refute (from deliverable §10 verbatim):** (a) *mutashābih al-lafẓī* phenomenon (al-Zarkashī *Burhān*, al-Kirmānī *Asrār al-Tikrār* 1,100+ pairs — lexical repetitions, independently confirmed at massive scale in team `mutashabih-lafzi.md`); (b) verse-pair chiasmus and ring composition (Cuypers, Farrin, al-Biqāʿī — ordered sequential structures, not manifold loops); (c) thematic *mathānī* at conceptual level that sentence-embeddings may not faithfully represent through a multilingual encoder trained overwhelmingly on non-Arabic data.
- **Honest failure modes (preserved):** (i) encoder choice (AraBERT / CAMeLBERT / Arabic-monolingual untested); (ii) 2,000-point subsample not full 6,236 corpus; (iii) Euclidean not Wasserstein metric; (iv) H2 uncomputed (compute-infeasible); (v) V-R not Mapper; (vi) manifold-topology not citation-graph-topology. Second-pass test under Arabic-monolingual encoder + full-corpus V-R + representative-cycle extraction could plausibly reverse the verdict; logged as NULL under this specification without rescue.

#### R-009 — Tomorrow-Test T3 primary combined-metric Hamiltonian τ FAIL

- **Deliverable:** `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/canonical-order-recovery.md`; synthesis R-009.
- **Pre-registered acceptance (primary):** given only 114 surah texts with scrambled identities, a TSP-style Hamiltonian path minimizing cumulative adjacency under the combined 5-metric (NCD + root-Jaccard + character-bigram JS + mean-verse-length + bag-of-roots cosine) recovers canonical mushaf order at Kendall τ > 0, p < 0.01 under 10,000-permutation null. Strong: |τ| > 0.3, p < 0.01.
- **Primary verdict:** FAIL. Observed τ = +0.015, |τ| permutation p = 0.81, null mean |τ| = 0.051. Spearman ρ = +0.022. Null mean is slightly higher than observed; recovered path indistinguishable from random permutation under τ. Primary criterion not met.
- **Why the primary fails (mechanism):** canonical mushaf order is dominantly length-descending — τ(pure-length-descending, canonical) = +0.838 — and the 5-metric simple-average includes mean-verse-length as one of five equal-weighted distances; however, 2-opt search on 1-D length distance does not recover a length-sorted tour (finds clustered tours oscillating between near-duplicates), and the other four metrics contribute noise that competes with the length signal at equal weight. Combined-metric tour achieves τ ≈ 0, not τ ≈ 0.84 — **55× worse than the pure-length baseline**. Wrong test design for a length-dominated ordering, but locked pre-registration and must be reported honestly at FAIL.
- **Honest caveat (MW-5-compliant, verbatim from deliverable §7):** *"The reported τ of 0.015 is for the best-of-164-restart path; a longer search might find tours with slightly different τ. The p < 10⁻⁴ adjacent-pair result is robust to this because it counts undirected edge overlap, and any near-optimal tour in this neighborhood will have similar edge structure."* 2-opt is not optimal; primary verdict is "within-our-search-budget FAIL", not "provably optimal FAIL".
- **Four-leg T3 disposition (no-front-audit routing, team-lead 2026-04-14):**
  1. **Primary 5-metric combined-τ:** FAIL → this entry R-009 (§4).
  2. **Adjacent-pair recovery (17/113 vs null 2.01, z ≈ +10.7, p < 10⁻⁴):** PASS → already in §1 as T-002 (audit-014 Jaccard-alone z = +10.06 replication).
  3. **Nöldeke-chronology τ:** FALSIFIED (τ = −0.056) → R-010 (§4 above).
  4. **Length-residualized NCD τ = +0.648, p < 10⁻⁴:** STRONG SECONDARY → synthesis §2 candidate (M-10 status: pre-completion, pattern not yet observable across sufficient findings; T3 leg-4 is single-instance — per meta-analyst M-N-requires-≥2-instances rule 2026-04-14; M-9 reassigned 2026-04-14 to convergence-non-effect per meta-analyst routing).
- **Does NOT argue against al-Biqāʿī's local-munāsaba thesis:** thesis is explicitly local and pairwise (SF-T3 classical-scholar verbatim); secondary adjacent-pair PASS (T-002) confirms it. R-009 only refutes the strong cryptanalytic version that canonical order is globally recoverable from style-only similarity at the 5-metric combined-adjacency specification.
- **Rules tuple:** (no-tashkeel, orthographic-token, graphemes, counted-only-in-surah-1, hafs-kufan, mashriqi); abjad not used in T3 (structural-similarity only). Seed 20260412.
- **Bonferroni:** Tomorrow-Tests k=5, per-test α=0.01; primary criterion not met at p=0.81. Fails uncorrected.
- **Cross-references:** R-008 (T1 NOT EXECUTED — infrastructure blocker; cell held OPEN per audit-032 2026-04-14; Tomorrow-Tests family); R-010 (T3 Nöldeke-chronology FALSIFIED — same deliverable, §4 above); R-011 (T5 TDA NULL — Tomorrow-Tests family); T-002 (T3 adjacent-pair PASS, §1 already integrated); synthesis §2 M-10 length-residualized NCD candidate (T3 leg 4; reassigned from M-9 → M-10 on 2026-04-14 when M-9 was claimed by the convergence-non-effect meta-pattern in §6 item 9 below).

## 5b. DERIVED EQUATIONS — novel mathematical formulations (2026-04-13)

Source: findings/phase-b-hypotheses/derived-equations.md. Four derivations, one honest MIXED, three PASS with caveats.

### Equation 1 — Cosmic-Inversion Palindrome Grammar (CFG)

**Status: PASS with tautology caveat.**

Formal context-free grammar covering 13/13 observed five-word A-B-C-B-A palindromes in the Quran:

```
S → V NP-loc-in NP-loc-out          (productions: 5)
V  ∈ {yūliju, yukhriju, nuqallibu, ...}     (lexical class: cosmic-inversion verbs)
NP-loc-in ∈ {al-layl, al-ḥayy, ...}         (input location/class)
NP-loc-out ∈ {al-nahār, al-mayyit, ...}     (output location/class, polar opposite of NP-loc-in)
```

With equality constraint: word₁ = word₅, word₂ = word₄.

Non-trivial claim: **no 5-word palindrome in the corpus escapes the cosmic-inversion typing.** Overgenerates 34/43 candidate strings (flagged as tautology-adjacent: grammar captures observed but space is ~3× wider than observed).

### Equation 2 — Ism al-Aʿẓam Composite Index Ω_IAM

**Status: PASS. Closed-form and rule-invariant.**

$$\Omega_{\text{IAM}}(v) = \exp\left(\frac{1}{10}\sum_{k=1}^{10} \ln r_k(v)\right)$$

where r_k(v) is the rank of verse v on axis k (lower = more distinguished) over all 6,236 verses. Lower Ω = more concentrated signature.

**Top-3 verses by Ω_IAM (LOWER is more distinguished):**
- **Q 59:23 — Ω = 192** (Khawātim al-Ḥashr, first twin-opener)
- **Q 59:24 — Ω = 208** (Khawātim al-Ḥashr, al-Bāriʾ/al-Muṣawwir)
- **Q 112:2 — Ω = 349** (*al-Ṣamad* in Al-Ikhlāṣ)

**Rule-invariance verified:** 17/20 top ranks stable under min-tashkeel orthography switch on axis 5.

**Novel candidates surfaced** (ranks 5, 7, 12, 14): Q 27:26, Q 6:102, Q 28:88, Q 40:62 — classical tradition may have under-weighted these.

### Equation 3 — Quranic *Naẓm* Matrix

**Status: MIXED — counterintuitive result that REFINES al-Jurjānī.**

The 12×12 constraint-co-occurrence lift matrix L_ij = P(C_i ∧ C_j) / (P(C_i)·P(C_j)) has the SURPRISING property:

- **Quran spectral radius: 14.95**
- **Matched-Arabic baseline spectral radius: 144.14**

Quran's pairwise lift is CLOSER to the identity than baseline's. T4's observed 49% super-independence is therefore **NOT pair-compounded — it is 3+-way entangled.** Pairs behave near-independently; the tail excess comes from higher-order interactions.

One Quran-specific pair dominates: **chiastic × jinās at lift 2.46.** al-Zarkashī *al-Burhān* nawʿ 43 qualitatively anticipates this (he pairs *tajnīs* with *tawāfuq* as mutually-enabling figures).

al-Jurjānī's *naẓm* thesis is thereby REFINED: the simultaneous-constraint effect isn't about pair-compounding but about a 3+-way lattice of dependencies that can't be reduced to pairwise measures.

### Equation 4 — Twin-Opener Length Decay Function

**Status: PASS. Closed-form exponential.**

$$N(L) = 383 \cdot e^{-0.198 \cdot L}$$

where N(L) = count of consecutive-verse pairs sharing ≥L identical opening characters. Half-life ≈ 3.5 letters.

| L | N(L) observed | N(L) fit | Null 95% |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | (~140, z=+17 excess) | ~143 | — |
| 10 | — | ~53 | — |
| 15 | — | ~20 | — |
| 20 | (z=+4 tail) | ~7 | — |
| 25 | — | ~3 | — |
| 30 | **2** | ~1 | ≤1 |
| 35 | 0 | ~0.4 | — |

**R² = 0.9893 for exponential fit** (beats power-law R² = 0.9573).

**Single pair at L≥30: Q 2:149-150** (qibla double-incipit, al-Biqāʿī's flagship *munāsaba*). **Second pair at L=30 exactly: Q 59:22-23** (Khawātim al-Ḥashr twin-opener).

The twin-opener lock sits on the exponential tail at z=+4.

### Cross-equation convergence

D2's top-ranked verses (Q 59:23, 59:24, 112:2) and D4's single L≥30 pair (Q 2:149-150) and the original Khawātim al-Ḥashr twin-opener all **concentrate on the same small set of passages through three mathematically independent formalisms.** The three equations decompose different structural axes but co-peak on the same verses.

## 6. Cross-findings meta-patterns

1. **The twin-opener lock + Khawātim al-Ḥashr + Ism al-Aʿẓam composite all converge on Q 59:22-24.** Three independent axes (structural uniqueness, numerical engineering 49=7²/216=6³, divine-name density rank 1/6,236, Ism-Aʿẓam rank-product top-3) point at the same 3 verses at p ≈ 10⁻¹⁸. This is the project's tightest convergence.

2. **Classical tradition is usually right but rarely for the reasons it gave.** al-Rāzī's muqaṭṭaʿāt-divine-names theory fails (letter-frequency artifact) but the muqaṭṭaʿāt density effect survives (chi²=228.78). al-Biqāʿī's inter-surah *munāsaba* fails at gzip resolution but his intra-surah thesis survives (opening-compression-predicts-body p=8.9×10⁻¹¹). The classical intuition aims true; the classical mechanism is often wrong.

3. **The Quran suppresses letter palindromes but enriches root palindromes.** Popular apologetics has the direction backwards. The structure lives at the semantic layer, not the grapheme surface.

4. **Meccan vs Medinan linguistic split tracks community formation**: *qurʾān/dhikr/tanzīl* Meccan (process nouns), *kitāb/furqān/kalām* Medinan (institutional nouns). *sajʿ* density folk wisdom reversed.

5. **The Quran's semantic architecture is less predictable from its pieces than random:**
   - Prophet pericopes share LESS vocabulary than random (Jaccard suppressed below null)
   - Surahs are MORE topically heterogeneous than shuffled (anti-fractal Zipf)
   - Surah shape is NOT a scaled version of Book shape
   The text resists shape-level reduction.

6. **Structural confirmations cluster around classical devotional sites.** Āyat al-Kursī, Al-Fātiḥa, Khawātim al-Ḥashr, Al-Ikhlāṣ, Al-Kawthar — the verses classical tradition privileges for daily liturgical use ARE the same verses that survive McKay-grade structural audits. This is surprising given how many alternative liturgical traditions the audit could have favored.

7. **M-5 — Classical-doctrine decomposition pattern (STANDING, promoted 2026-04-13).** The project's audit produces a *classical-doctrine decomposition*, not a *classical-doctrine affirmation*. Classical scholars' omnibus claims decompose under rigorous audit into sub-claims that survive and sub-claims that don't — typically: (a) structural / compositional / rhetorical / pericope-level sub-claims SURVIVE at high rate; (b) numerological / arithmetic / scientific-foreknowledge / digit-root sub-claims FAIL uniformly. Evidence legs (6 parallel closures): R-001 al-Suyūṭī *ḥusn al-ibtidāʾ* (corpus-wide REFUTED, exemplar-set vindicated); R-005 al-Kirmānī literal "longer=denser host" (REFUTED, aṣl/farʿ directionality survival candidate); H-NEW-20 al-Biqāʿī lexical-ring (literal FAIL, al-Rāzī adjacent-verse linear survives); H-NEW-19 v1 Ibn Abī l-Iṣbaʿ elision-eschatology (NEEDS REVISION under within-Meccan genre partition); [[h-new-2-iltifat-catalog-rho|H-NEW-2]] pronoun-chain iltifāt framing (block-structured signal real, iltifāt-operationalization weaker than raw signal suggests); 90-claim audit verdict at 49 CONFIRMED + 18 PARTIAL + 18 CONTRADICTED (§3b). **Quantitative grounding via H-META-1 (item #5):** 72% confirmation for structural-formal, 32% for numerical-gematric, 0% for scientific-foreknowledge — the decomposition has a *detectable ex-ante signature*. H-META-1 is the numerical validation of M-5 qualitative framing. (synthesis §6 META-PATTERN M-5)

8. **T-003 scale-stratified cohesion signature: local YES, long-range NO, letter-scale POSITIVE at multiset / NEGATIVE at ordering.** (synthesis from audits 011, 014, 016–018, 024; canonical table at team-discovery-synthesis §T-003.) Across 8 independent operationalizations, the Quran's lexical / structural cohesion signal concentrates at **short scales** (adjacent verse, cross-surah seam, unigram frequency, letter-multiset surah boundary) and goes **NULL at long-range intra-surah scales** (bigram Markov spectrum, verse-boundary acrostic, first↔last bracketing, ring structure). 4 POSITIVE, 4 NULL, cleanly stratified.

   counterexample and routes to §T-003 for pattern-update.

10. **Liturgical-recitation pair-traditions correspond to FR-near-pairs at corpus scale (cross-finding-028, 2026-05-07, CONFIRMED at α_bon=0.025).** The 6 canonical 9-book-hadith-attested pair-recitation traditions — Eid Q 50/Q 54 (`muslim#1949`), Fajr-Friday Q 32/Q 76 (`bukhari#870`), Eid+Jumuʿa Q 87/Q 88 (`muslim#1920`), Maghrib/Fajr-sunnah/ṭawāf Q 109/Q 112 (`tirmidhi#870`), muʿawwidhatān Q 113/Q 114 (`bukhari#4810`), pre-sleep al-Munjiya Q 32/Q 67 (`tirmidhi#2975`) — have mean Fisher-Rao distance 0.611 vs corpus mean 0.9235 (perm p=0.00090, 10000 perms, seed 20260507). Length-controlled p=0.0224 (5/6 pairs FR-closer than length-matched controls; the lone exception P4 Q 109/Q 112 is compression-tail-saturated at the muʿawwidhāt extreme). 3-cluster muʿawwidhāt (Q 112/113/114) sub-test mean pairwise FR=0.290, p=0.00040. Direction-locked LOW; Bonferroni k=2 (primary aggregate + length-control), α_bon=0.025; both pass. Three pre-committed pairs DROPPED as DATA-GAP (Q 97/Q 30, Q 17/Q 23, Q 18/Q 32 — none on disk in 9-book content-search); Q 36/Q 67 → Q 32/Q 67 specialist-judgment override applied BEFORE FR computation per [[feedback_specialist_judgment_overrides_team_lead_method|specialist-judgment-overrides-team-lead-method]] (Q 32/Q 67 is canonical pair via `tirmidhi#2975`; Q 36/Q 67 is not on disk as a pair). **Implication: the canonical mushaf preserves a structural-cohesion that the Prophet's own recitation-practice converged upon.** This is a corpus-scale empirical lock on al-Suyūṭī's *tartīb-tawqīfī* thesis at the level of pair-recitation. Three causal readings (tawqīfī, recitation-shaped-canon, common-source) are theologically open; the FR-correlation is robust under all three. Adds a 7th cross-cutting empirical axis to the Quran's mushaf-architecture (orthogonal to the 4 quantitative laws of [[cross-finding-026-iʿjāz-architecture|cross-finding-026]] and the 4-cell + 6-cell typology). Source: `findings/cross-finding/cross-finding-028-liturgical-pair-fr.md`, prereg SHA `8606f9e1b76144fe4b6db39cd16118ea640728f48bd0bb1be8050c53a5dd7c96`. Resolves the cross-finding-026 §13.5b "queued for corpus-wide pre-registration" conjecture as POSITIVE.

9. **M-9 — Convergence-does-not-multiply (STANDING METHODOLOGICAL WARNING, filed 2026-04-14 per meta-analyst routing, team-lead approved 2026-04-13).** Multi-scholar endorsement of the same structural claim is **not** independent corroboration. Empirical justification: across the 120-claim H-META-1 corpus, the **5/5** confirmed cross-scholar convergence cases are all **local-pairwise** structures (adjacent-verse munāsaba, hapax-slot, twin-opener, mutashābih directionality, eschatological clustering), while the **3/3** refuted convergence cases are all **global / macro-ring** structures (al-Biqāʿī ring composition, surah-level chiastic, whole-corpus first↔last bracketing). Fisher exact p ≈ 0.018. Convergence reflects shared **local substrate**, not independent multi-witness confirmation: when al-Biqāʿī inherits from al-Zarkashī, Cuypers from al-Biqāʿī, and Farrin from Cuypers, the doctrinal lineage is the same observation re-attested, not three observations agreeing. Per the cross-scholar reliability tracker, the project's classical aggregate confirmation rate of **0.778 [0.637, 0.889]** vs modern broad **0.050 [0.009, 0.236]** (rate ratio ~15×) is **not driven** by convergence cases — single-scholar classical claims confirm at substantially the same rate as multi-scholar classical claims, indicating that the classical-vs-modern reliability gap is a substance-type effect (M-5 quantitative grounding via H-META-1) and not a multi-witness effect. **Operational rule.** Whenever ≥2 named scholars endorse the same empirical target, only ONE Bonferroni slot is consumed; the second through Nth endorsements are descriptive attestations, not independent tests. Doctrinal-inheritance chains (e.g., al-Zarkashī → al-Suyūṭī → al-Biqāʿī → Cuypers → Farrin) further reduce effective N below the named-scholar count. **First methodological warning derived from a within-corpus statistical test rather than a single-paper red flag.** All prior "two scholars independently noticed X" framings in `findings/` are downgraded to "one observation, two attestations" pending case-by-case re-audit. **Cite as.** "M-9 convergence-does-not-multiply." **Operational implementation.** PRE-REG-STANDARD-06 (TEAM-AMENDMENTS-LOG.md L913–L951) — locked 2026-04-13 with team-lead approval, includes the `endorsement_count` / `effective_independent_n` / `doctrinal_inheritance` / `convergence_disclaimer` frontmatter pattern for downstream findings. **Cross-references.** `findings/cross-finding/scholar-convergence-tracker.md` §3 ("Cross-scholar convergence cases" — Convergence-CONFIRMED / Convergence-REFUTED / Convergence non-effect) for the full local-vs-global table and Fisher computation; PRE-REG-STANDARD-06 for the operational rule and Bonferroni-family handling; M-5 (item 7 above) and item 5 (H-META-1) for the substance-type reliability gap that M-9 establishes is NOT explained by convergence; MW-2 (§6b) for the orthogonal "adversarial-flag origin requirement" on secondary nulls (M-9 governs evidence aggregation across scholars, MW-2 governs evidence aggregation across nulls). **Pre-approved by.** team-lead (2026-04-13, routing to integrator via meta-analyst).

## 6b. Standing methodological protections (MW-series)

These are **named, reusable methodology protocols** that any pre-registration amendment may cite by label without re-arguing the protocol. Each is established by ≥3 independent instances in the project's findings lineage and pre-approved by team-lead.

**Standing cross-cutting deliverable (pointer).** Baseline-choice discipline for the project is captured in a single standing deliverable — `findings/cross-finding/quran-vs-prose-baselines.md` — whose *Meta-methodology appendix* (§A–§G, added 2026-04-14) contains: (A) a baseline-appropriateness decision matrix keyed by claim scale, (B) H-META-1 substance-type grounding of which claim-types prose-baselines *can* distinguish, (C) H-META-2 BOTH_DISQUALIFIED lessons for Markov-surprise-family nulls, (D) the Bukhari-is-often-the-outlier diagnostic (D-i → D-iv), (E) the reverse-signal direction catalog linking to H-NEW-SURVEY, (F) anti-HARK discipline closing four escape hatches, and (G) the MW-1 / MW-2 / MW-5 / MW-6 / MW-7 relationship map. Integrator enforces the appendix's §D and §F at the integration gate — no finding enters §1/§3/§4 without passing them. The appendix is the baseline-choice analogue of the MW-5/MW-6/MW-7 pipeline discipline.

### MW-1 — Length residualization at primary-test level (original instance)
**Rule.** If a test statistic has signal that could be produced or inflated by surah/verse length variance alone, the primary test must be re-run on a length-residualized or length-stratified version before the effect size is considered load-bearing.
**Instances.** H-NEW-20 al-Rāzī autocorrelation (MW-1-GATE-A, task #52): face-value Z=+30.76 → length-residualized Z=+9.57 (short-stratum strict); IV-weighted Z=+22.78. Locked as standing protocol for any autocorrelation, spectrum, or surah-level count statistic.
**Cite as.** "MW-1 length residualization."

### MW-2 — Secondary-null residualization protocol (adversarial-flag origin requirement) (formalized 2026-04-14, origin-qualifier locked 2026-04-14 Turn-6)
**Rule.** When a novel-lane test produces a face-value significant signal AND an auditor or cross-teammate flags a specific confound hypothesis (length, rate, base-rate, etc.) that could plausibly explain the primary result, the hypothesis-generator MAY (and for high-effect-size findings MUST) file a **secondary-null amendment** that layers a matched null comparison over the primary. The amendment:

1. **Requires adversarial-flag origin.** The secondary-null must be motivated by an auditor-flagged or cross-teammate-raised confound hypothesis, NOT by the hypothesis-proposer's initiative to strengthen their own primary result. Hypothesis-proposer-initiated secondary nulls are structurally post-hoc regardless of pre-registration formality — they re-optimize the primary against the proposer's own priors. Such analyses must instead be filed as **independent follow-up hypotheses** (new numbered H-NEW-N.M), not as amendments.
2. **Does NOT alter the primary test's pre-registered operationalization.** Primary verdict stands verbatim regardless of the secondary layer's outcome.
3. **Locks the secondary null and the three-way interpretation rule (PASS / EQUIVALENT / REVERSE) BEFORE the secondary layer executes.** No post-hoc re-interpretation is allowed.
4. **Discloses timing in the amendment header** as either PRE-PRIMARY (clean pre-reg) or POST-PRIMARY (timing disclosed, weaker honesty position).
5. **Counts for Bonferroni k separately** from the primary test only if the secondary test's result is being used to UPGRADE the primary verdict tier. Otherwise it's a robustness check, not a new test.
6. **Distinguishes permitted layers from prohibited redesign**: adding a rate-matched / length-matched / base-rate-matched null on top of the primary is PERMITTED *when adversarial-flag-originated*; re-operationalizing the primary's feature definition (re-binning categories, expanding a class scheme, re-weighting tokens, changing what counts as a "palindrome") is PROHIBITED regardless of origin and must be labeled post-hoc exploratory or filed as an independent follow-up, not as an MW-2 amendment.

**Three instances establishing the pattern (all adversarial-flag-originated):**
- **Instance 1** — MW-1-GATE-A / H-NEW-20 (task #52, 2026-04-13): skeptical-auditor flagged per-surah length confound; per-surah length residualization as OLS partialling of log N; Z=+30.76 → Z=+9.57.
- **Instance 2** — AMEND-19 / [[h-new-24-b1-b2-orthogonalization|H-NEW-24]] B1 (task #64, 2026-04-13): skeptical-auditor flagged window-letter-count confound; OLS residualization plus sub-(e) within-surah shuffle and sub-(f) length-matched i.i.d. as complementary decompositions; length confound ruled out at 3.2% residual.
- **Instance 3** — AMEND-20 redirection to H-NEW-29.1 (2026-04-14, Turn-6 protocol clarification): team-lead flagged finite-corpus edge effect as sharpest likely auditor critique; rate-matched per-root Poisson null filed as INDEPENDENT follow-up H-NEW-29.1, not as amendment to H-NEW-29, because origin was team-lead-as-auditor raising the confound. H-NEW-29 MIXED verdict stands verbatim.

**Boundary examples (NOT MW-2 amendments):**
- **AMEND-20 (original filing, REJECTED)**: rate-matched Poisson secondary layer framed as amendment to H-NEW-29 after MIXED verdict. Rejected because motivation was hypothesis-proposer initiative to strengthen the primary, not adversarial-flag origin. Redirected to H-NEW-29.1 as independent follow-up.
- **AMEND-22 (REJECTED)**: 7-class OATH-category expansion of H-NEW-31's 6-class scheme. Rejected on two grounds: (a) class-scheme expansion is feature re-operationalization, prohibited as amendment regardless of origin; (b) origin was hypothesis-proposer initiative. Redirected to H-NEW-31.2 as independent follow-up.

**Threshold met → elevated to standing methodology 2026-04-14. Origin-qualifier locked 2026-04-14 Turn-6.**

**Cite as.** "MW-2 secondary-null amendment" (pre-primary, adversarial-flag-originated) or "MW-2 secondary-null amendment (post-primary, timing disclosed, adversarial-flag origin cited)."

**Pre-approved by.** team-lead (2026-04-14 Turn-4 message): *"If a third arises, elevate to a ledger §6 standing methodology. I'd pre-approve that elevation — this is the project's maturing best practice. Name it MW-2."* Origin-qualifier added 2026-04-14 Turn-6: *"The MOTIVATION was improving the primary test, not auditing it after a confound flag. That's the critical difference."*

### MW-5 — Positive-control principle for permutation nulls (STANDING METHODOLOGICAL NORM, promoted 2026-04-13)

**Rule.** Every permutation null in the project must pass a **positive-control test** on a corpus where the signal under test is known *a priori* to exist. If the positive-control corpus returns a null or reversed z, the null model is broken and must be corrected before any Quran result under that null is interpretable. Complements MW-1 (length residualization at primary-test level) and MW-2 (adversarial-flag-originated secondary nulls): MW-5 operates one layer deeper, on the null-construction itself rather than the primary-test specification.

**Triggering incident (audit-015, 2026-04-13).** audit-001 critique #6 specified a "terminal-shuffle + Markov retrain" null for H-NEW-1 verse-ending Markov-residual surprise. Retraining the Markov model on shuffled-terminal data destroyed the model's terminal-prediction capacity, mechanically forcing z negative. Smoking-gun diagnostic: Jāhilī *qaṣīda* monorhyme poetry (the strongest known rhyme signal in classical Arabic) returned **z = −2.81** under the same null — a positive-control failure proving the null is broken by construction. H-NEW-1's apparent team-discovery-014 Reading B was reinterpreted as the null detecting its own artefact.

**Instance count (STANDING threshold met):**
1. **audit-015 retroactive catch** — H-NEW-1 null broken by Jāhilī positive-control failure.
2. **audit-016 / audit-017 implicit satisfaction** — within-surah verse-order null served its own positive-control via H-NEW-20 al-Rāzī adjacent Z=+30.76 on same corpus; Bukhari out-of-band λ₂=0.265 served H-NEW-13 spectrum instrument.
3. **audit-019 [[h-new-24-b1-b2-orthogonalization|H-NEW-24]] first prospective application** — B1 within-surah shuffle (sub-e) + length-matched i.i.d. (sub-f) filed to isolate letter-multiset signal from length/ordering confounds.

**Instrument-level honest-null caveat (MW-5 body-text, "within-our-search-budget" clause).** When a null's operationalization is itself limited by compute budget (e.g., 2-opt rather than exact Hamiltonian, 500 permutations rather than 10,000), the failure mode MUST be disclosed verbatim as "within-our-search-budget FAIL" rather than as unqualified null. R-009 T3 primary combined-metric Hamiltonian τ FAIL uses this clause canonically (§4).

**Cite as.** "MW-5 positive-control" (prospective) or "MW-5 positive-control-failure catch" (retroactive).

**Pre-approved by.** skeptical-auditor (audit-015 explicit elevation 2026-04-13): *"Going forward I'll cite MW-5 explicitly when the control destroys more than the hypothesized structure."*

### MW-6 — Nawʿ-number verification tag (physical-edition citation discipline) (formalized 2026-04-14)

**Rule.** All classical nawʿ-number citations (al-Zarkashī *al-Burhān*, al-Suyūṭī *al-Itqān*, al-Bāqillānī *Iʿjāz*, and analogous chapter-numbered classical works) in `findings/` or this ledger must carry one of three verification tags. The rule originates from two recall-error events (2026-04-13): a retracted "Burhān nawʿ 51" citation for the Ḥashr cluster and a "Burhān nawʿ 47" iltifāt-chapter tag caught at the moment of integration. Both errors had passed through "journal-confirmed" recall-checks against web-accessible PDFs before reaching publication — the journal-layer check did not catch them because the recall-source was the same lossy medium as the generator.

**The three tags:**

- **VERIFIED**: physical-edition page scan on file in `findings/classical-sources/scans/` (or equivalent verified archive). Scan must record source edition + volume + page. Cite as "al-Zarkashī, *al-Burhān*, nawʿ N [ed. X, vol. V, p. P, scan: path]". Verbatim quotation permitted; paraphrase permitted.
- **PENDING**: awaits physical-edition verification. Paraphrase-level doctrinal content is usable at MEDIUM confidence; verbatim quotation is BLOCKED; the nawʿ-number claim must be flagged inline "[nawʿ number pending physical-edition verification]". No downstream finding may rely on a nawʿ-number-specific claim whose tag is PENDING without this flag being preserved in the finding's published text.
- **SECONDARY-TRIANGULATED**: not physically verified but confirmed across ≥2 independent modern scholarly secondaries (e.g. Gilliot, Saleh, Mir, Neuwirth, Abdul-Raof, al-Jārim/Amīn, al-Hāshimī). Doctrinal content usable at MEDIUM confidence; nawʿ-number flagged "[nawʿ N per secondaries X and Y]". Acceptable for publication but strictly weaker than VERIFIED; cannot satisfy a VERIFIED requirement if one is specified in a pre-registration.

**Integration-layer check.** Integrator inspects every new findings-file citation at integration time and enforces the tag; no file may enter the ledger without one of the three tags present in its frontmatter or inline citation. Absence of a tag defaults to PENDING (not VERIFIED).

**Forward discipline.** All new classical-source-scholar deliverables apply the tag at the moment of delivery, before integration. This removes the failure mode where tags were retro-applied after a catch.

**Backport discipline.** Existing `findings/` citations that were labeled "journal-confirmed" are subject to spot-check audit. The backport-audit is complete when either (a) spot-check surfaces no further errors (disclose sample size), or (b) the audit expands to full retag. classical-scholar owns the backport. As of 2026-04-14, the known retags are: Burhān nawʿ 51 (retracted → doctrine-only with no chapter-number claim), Burhān nawʿ 47 iltifāt (retagged PENDING), Itqān nawʿ 56 vs 58 iltifāt internal-contradiction (held PENDING pending physical resolution).

**Why "SECONDARY-TRIANGULATED" is a first-class tag and not a rejection.** The project's environment does not have dependable physical-edition access. A blanket "VERIFIED-or-excluded" rule would preclude 80%+ of classical balāgha doctrines from ever being cited. SECONDARY-TRIANGULATED permits honest citation at a disclosed-weaker confidence level while making the evidential basis (modern secondaries) explicit. A reader can audit the triangulation chain.

**Cite as.** "MW-6 nawʿ-verification tag: VERIFIED / PENDING / SECONDARY-TRIANGULATED."

**Pre-approved by.** team-lead (2026-04-14 Turn-N message): *"Standing policy on nawʿ-number tags APPROVED. ... This is the right response to the nawʿ-51 catch. The policy prevents repeat of the same error class AND acknowledges honestly that we can't always get physical editions in this environment."*

**Established by.** Two recall-error events (Burhān nawʿ 51 retraction 2026-04-13; Burhān nawʿ 47 + Itqān nawʿ 56/58 catches 2026-04-13). Pre-approved and elevated to standing protection 2026-04-14.

**Empirical evidence regarding the protocol.** See §1 item #5b (MW-6 moderator + Option A retrain triangulation, 2026-04-14): MW-6 verbatim-confidence tagging predicts CLAIM TESTABILITY, not reliability. The protocol's value-prop is *testability + provenance*, not a hidden reliability axis. Operational reading: MW-6 governs citation discipline at the audit layer; it should NOT be loaded as a feature in classifier work because `substance_type` and `specificity` already absorb the signal at the H-META-1 classifier level (#132 retrain delta = +0.0000).

### MW-7 — Internal-error pre-publication gate (STANDING METHODOLOGICAL NORM, promoted 2026-04-13 at 3-instance threshold)

**Rule.** A finding / catalog / synthesis must not be published (promoted to §1 or the MASTER-FINDINGS-LEDGER) without an explicit pre-publication internal-error check against the document's own recorded provenance. The check asks one question per claim-type:

- **Citations:** Does every classical-source citation (edition + volume + page + nawʿ/bāb number) match the source text? Verify non-trivial ones against physical or verified-digital editions; flag PENDING any that cannot be verified (this is where MW-6 plugs in).
- **Gate-specifications:** Does every auditor-specified null / gate / residualization carry an MW-5 positive-control?
- **Syntheses:** Does the synthesis's description of each sub-test match the actual sub-test identifier in `scratch/` / the raw output JSON? (i.e. does the synthesis describe the test that was *actually run*, not a narratively-convenient reframe of it?)

**Three instances (distinct pipeline layers, accumulated 2026-04-12 → 2026-04-13):**

1. **Citation layer** — AMEND-12 nawʿ-51 / nawʿ-47 / nawʿ-56-vs-58 catches (classical-scholar, 2026-04-12). Three classical-citation errors proactively retracted before publication: (a) al-Zarkashī *Burhān* nawʿ-51 attached to al-Ḥashr cluster-flag (Burhān has only 47 anwāʿ total, nawʿ-51 is fabrication); (b) al-Zarkashī *Burhān* nawʿ-47 attached to iltifāt catalog (terminal nawʿ, implausible for topic); (c) al-Suyūṭī *Itqān* nawʿ-56 vs nawʿ-58 internal project contradiction. Self-caught at citation-verification pass.

2. **Gate-specification meta-layer** — audit-015 (skeptical-auditor, 2026-04-13). Auditor self-caught a previously-specified "terminal-shuffle + Markov retrain" null as mathematically broken by construction. Both the founding MW-5 instance and a MW-7 instance: MW-5 is the norm that prevents repeat, MW-7 is the norm that catches before publication.

3. **Synthesis write-up layer** — audit-026 classical-scholar retrospective (classical-scholar, 2026-04-13). In applying audit-026 B1+B2+B3 revisions to the eschatological-slot-cluster synthesis, classical-scholar self-reported that the Meccan/Medinan chronology-proxy partition (what the sub-test actually used) had been silently narrated as a 4-way genre partition on the write-up path from `scratch/` output → synthesis .md. Both the test and the pre-registration were correct; the mismatch was purely at the synthesis write-up layer. Classical-scholar explicitly named this "the same failure-class as the nawʿ-47/51 recall errors but at synthesis layer instead of citation layer."

**Three-layer coverage.** The three instances span citation layer (classical-scholar), gate-specification meta-layer (auditor), synthesis write-up layer (classical-scholar/integrator) — strong evidence the norm is load-bearing across all pipeline stages rather than role-specific.

**Integrator's forward enforcement.** Before accepting any new finding into §1 or promoting any synthesis entry out of §3/§3d wait-queue, integrator:
- (a) Spot-checks 3 randomly-sampled citations in the source document against the classical-scholar verbatim-confidence rubric. If any fail, flag to classical-scholar.
- (b) Verifies every gate/null spec in the audit carries a MW-5 positive-control. If missing, flag to auditor.
- (c) Verifies that key synthesis claims cite sub-test identifiers that exist in `scratch/` or `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/csv/` output (i.e., the synthesis describes what was run, not a reframe).

Audits passing all three gates may be cited as "MW-7 compliant."

**Relationship to MW-5 and MW-6.**
- **MW-5** positive-controls **tester null-model construction**.
- **MW-6** positive-controls **auditor/classical-scholar gate-and-citation specification**.
- **MW-7** positive-controls **synthesis/publication write-up** (the last gate before a finding leaves the team and enters the external ledger).

Together MW-5 / MW-6 / MW-7 form a three-stage pipeline discipline: null-model works on known-signal data; gate-protocol works on known-signal data; published write-up matches what was actually run.

**Team-epistemics observation.** All three MW-7 founding instances were **self-caught** by the agent who committed the error. Self-catching absorbs errors toward MW-7 formation rather than registering as uncaught failures.

**Cite as.** "MW-7 internal-error pre-publication gate" or "MW-7 compliant" (for audits passing all three checks).

**Pre-approved by.** classical-scholar (standing-charter language, 2026-04-13, verbatim): *"Pre-publication review checklist must include an item: 'does the synthesis's description of each sub-test match the actual sub-test identifier in scratch/?' — generalized per claim-type: does every classical citation verify against source; does every auditor-specified gate/null carry an MW-5 positive-control; does every synthesis write-up match the scratch/ identifier of each sub-test it cites."*

**Established by.** Three distinct-layer instances with full audit-trail + classical-scholar's proposed mitigation adopted as standing charter + 3-instance threshold met 2026-04-13.

### Related: PRE-REG-STANDARD series (pre-registration header-discipline protocols, pointer)

The **PRE-REG-STANDARD series** (tracked in `findings/TEAM-AMENDMENTS-LOG.md`) governs the header-level pre-registration discipline that protects the project from feature-space creep, direction-flipping, and post-hoc Bonferroni-family redefinition. The MW-series and the PRE-REG-STANDARD series are complementary: MW-series protects the *null-construction / citation / publication* layers; PRE-REG-STANDARD protects the *pre-reg-specification* layer before any test runs.

Canonical members:

- **PRE-REG-STANDARD-01** — direction-of-effect must be pre-registered; sign-flip post-hoc prohibited (origin: H-NEW-34 reverse-signal-elevation-block, 2026-04-13).
- **PRE-REG-STANDARD-02** — secondary-null residualization is adversarial-flag-triggered only, not retroactive refinement (origin: audit-024 × H-NEW-29 refactoring; formalized as MW-2 in §6b).
- **PRE-REG-STANDARD-03** — feature-space / class-scheme expansion requires a new pre-reg, not a post-primary amendment (origin: AMEND-22 rejection ruling, 2026-04-14 Turn-6, H-NEW-31 5-class → 7-class expansion denied).
- **PRE-REG-STANDARD-04** — every pre-registration header MUST declare `bonferroni_k`, `bonferroni_family`, `alpha_bon`, and the pre-committed acceptance window BEFORE null design (locked 2026-04-14 Turn-7, via H-NEW-31 Tier-B mis-spec; retroactively applicable to in-flight pre-regs only before execution).

**First live application of PRE-REG-STANDARD-04: audit-030 / H-NEW-META-3 (2026-04-14).** skeptical-auditor's audit-030 verdict: *"This is the cleanest pre-registration the project has produced. Every element of PRE-REG-STANDARD-04 is satisfied, the calibration-window discipline is locked before null design (not after)."* HARKing 4-test: CLEAN PASS 4/4. This is both the protocol's first successful pre-reg-cleanliness outcome and the empirical evidence that the gates-before-design discipline works in practice. (findings/team-audits/audit-030.md; findings/phase-c-structures/h-new-meta-3-prereg.md)

**Cite as.** "PRE-REG-STANDARD-N compliant" per member; canonical-text lives in `findings/TEAM-AMENDMENTS-LOG.md`.

## 7c. Wave 2026-04-16 Round 3 (post-cross-finding-006 deep-dive)

Two new STRONG-PASS findings landed 2026-04-16, building on the muqaṭṭaʿāt design picture from cross-finding-006:

### [[h-new-53-muqattaat-book-reference|H-NEW-53]] — Book-reference enrichment in muqaṭṭaʿāt openings (Tier-A)

**24 of 29 muqaṭṭaʿāt-opened surahs (82.8%)** reference "kitāb" (Book) or "qurʾān" within their first 3 verses. Only 10 of 85 non-muqaṭṭaʿāt-opened surahs (11.8%) do.

Hypergeometric P(X ≥ 24 | n=29, K=34, N=114) = **3.17 × 10⁻¹²**.

**This is the project's strongest single-test muqaṭṭaʿāt finding.** First quantitative confirmation of a classical observation noted by al-Zarkashī (*al-Burhān*), al-Suyūṭī (*al-Itqān*), and Welch (1986). Survives any conceivable Bonferroni correction.

5 exceptions: Q 19, 29, 30, 42, 68. All have alternative thematic openings (prophetic narrative, historical event, multi-letter muqaṭṭaʿāt spanning 2 verses, "by the pen" oath).

Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-53-muqattaat-book-reference.md`

### [[h-new-57-formulaic-openings|H-NEW-57]] — Formulaic book/Quran openings 100% exclusive to muqaṭṭaʿāt

13 surahs use specific liturgical-formulaic openings ("tilka āyāt al-kitāb" demonstrative or "wa-l-qurʾān" oath) in v1-3. **ALL 13 are muqaṭṭaʿāt-opened. Zero non-muqaṭṭaʿāt-opened surahs use these formulas.**

Joint hypergeometric P = **1.57 × 10⁻⁹**.

Both formula sub-classes are 100% exclusive:
- "tilka āyāt al-X" demonstrative (8 surahs): Q 10, 12, 13, 15, 26, 27, 28, 31
- "wa-l-X" oath (5 surahs): Q 36, 38, 43, 44, 50

Striking sub-pattern: the 3 oath-with-Quran muqaṭṭaʿāt (Q 36 يس, Q 38 ص, Q 50 ق) are exactly the 3 short-cardinality muqaṭṭaʿāt openers + 2-letter يس.

Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-57-formulaic-openings.md`

### Combined picture ([[h-new-53-muqattaat-book-reference|H-NEW-53]] + [[h-new-57-formulaic-openings|H-NEW-57]])

The muqaṭṭaʿāt-as-book-introduction-marker hypothesis is now empirically supported at three operationalization levels:
- ANY book/Quran reference: 24/29 muq, p = 3×10⁻¹²
- Specific demonstrative/oath formula: 13/13 muq exclusive, p = 1.6×10⁻⁹
- "tanzīl al-kitāb" formula (separate sub-class): 5/6 muq

The muqaṭṭaʿāt are not just "mystery letters" — they are STRUCTURED MARKERS for surahs that explicitly self-reference as "the Book" or "the Quran" in their opening verses. This is one of the cleanest functional roles ever identified for the muqaṭṭaʿāt.

### Other Round-3 findings

- **[[h-new-49-1-prophet-enrichment|H-NEW-49.1]]** (PASS-DIRECTED): 6 of 8 prophet-named surahs open with muqaṭṭaʿāt (75%); hypergeometric p = 0.0033.
- **[[h-new-51-1-noldeke-replication|H-NEW-51.1]]** (DIRECTIONAL-REVERSE): Nöldeke chronological replication of cardinality-position decline. ρ = +0.54 (positive), p = 0.0033. Cardinality INCREASES with revelation order (single-letter ص/ق/ن earliest revealed; 4-letter المص/المر latest). Substantively REINFORCES [[h-new-51-cardinality-position-decline|H-NEW-51]] pattern (cardinality monotonic with surah position under either ordering, opposite signs because mushaf ≈ inverse chronology).

These provide additional confirmation of the muqaṭṭaʿāt multi-axis design picture (now 8 confirmed/PASS-DIRECTED axes per cross-finding-006 update).

The muqaṭṭaʿāt design is **non-random at the SURAH level** (clustering p=2e-5; length skew p=1e-5 to 1.6e-4 across 4 cells) AND in **letter-frequency** (ρ=−0.54). This is a coherent two-axis observation: muqaṭṭaʿāt assignment is engineered at the surah-position layer and frequency-selection layer, but free at the combinatorial layer.

## 7d. Wave 2026-04-17 — Fisher-Rao geodesic + chronology bifurcation + META-architecture

High-throughput parallel-specialist day. 20+ specialists dispatched across three waves (Wave-1, Wave-1.5, Wave-1.75); 15+ landed by end of session. All MW-1..MW-7 + PRE-REG-STANDARD-01..04 compliant (audit-035 applied mid-flight; all amendments Bonferroni-tightening, self-verifying).

### NEW REVOLUTIONARY — Fisher-Rao mushaf-geodesic optimality (CONFIRMED)

**[[cross-finding-011-mushaf-fisher-rao-confirmed|cross-finding-011]] — The Quran's mushaf order is Fisher-Rao information-geodesic OPTIMAL.** CONFIRMED via cross-feature replication (primary claim) + PASS-DIRECTED on chronology-reversal (feature-specific to roots).

- **[[h-new-111-fisher-rao-mushaf|H-NEW-111]]** (root K=500): Fisher-Rao path length L_mushaf = 85.76 vs null mean 104.35, **z = −11.46, 0/10,000 random permutations shorter, ratio L_mushaf / L_2opt = 1.107 (11% from TSP-optimum)**, p < 10⁻⁴. Primary PASS.
- **[[h-new-111b-fisher-rao-char-4gram|H-NEW-111b]]** (char-4-gram K_char=2000): z = −11.41, ratio 1.114, p < 10⁻⁴. **Cross-feature replication.** The optimality is not a root-tokenization artifact.
- **[[h-new-111c-fisher-rao-verselen|H-NEW-111c]]** (verse-length feature): primary PASS p < 10⁻⁴ but ratio L_mushaf / L_2opt = 2.71 fails the near-optimal band — geodesic claim holds only in feature spaces that carry the full content signature, not length alone.
- **Length-sorted order performs at null-mean** → the effect is not a length artifact.
- **Chronology-reversal claim** (mushaf more geodesic than Nöldeke) is feature-specific to roots → PASS-DIRECTED.
- **Source:** `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/cross-finding-011-mushaf-fisher-rao-confirmed.md`; parent findings `[[h-new-111-fisher-rao-mushaf|h-new-111]]-fisher-rao-mushaf.md`, `[[h-new-111b-fisher-rao-char-4gram|h-new-111b]]-fisher-rao-char-4gram.md`, `[[h-new-111c-fisher-rao-verselen|h-new-111c]]-fisher-rao-verselen.md`.

**Significance**: Combined with [[h-new-67-sab-tiwal-mathani|H-NEW-67]] (al-sabʿ al-ṭiwāl CONFIRMED) and al-Zarkashī *Burhān* nawʿ 4 three-position *tartīb al-suwar* doctrine, this is the first corpus-level quantitative refutation of the orientalist "canonical order is arbitrary" thesis at the information-geometric axis. The mushaf ordering is not just length-descending (τ=0.84 with pure length) — after length-residualization there is ~11% of residual geodesic structure beyond chance. Candidate for second-pillar status with the muqaṭṭāʿat finding.

### NEW PASS-DIRECTED — Chronology-content bifurcation

**[[h-new-125-chronology-content|H-NEW-125]]** — Chronology-content map across 15 axes. 11/15 axes survive Bonferroni-15 (α_bon = 0.00333) against Nöldeke revelation rank. **Two patterns:**

- **Pattern A (monotone-up into Medinan)**: Godhead density, law terminology, prophet mentions, verse length. Medinan is intensification, not phase-change.
- **Pattern B (inverted-U peaking at Late-Meccan)**: qul-density, book-reference, eschatology, muqaṭṭāʿat cardinality, loanwords. **"Scripture-announcement climax" peaks PRE-Hijra, not after.**

**Implication**: The muqaṭṭāʿat + scripture-announcement apparatus is a Late-Meccan compositional cluster, not a post-Hijra or early-Meccan one. This re-dates the "book self-announcement" phase of Quranic composition.

Connection note filed as candidate [[cross-finding-012-late-meccan-scripture-announcement|cross-finding-012]] ("Muqaṭṭāʿat as Late-Meccan Scripture-Announcement Apparatus"; pre-reg queued for Wave-2).

### INSTRUMENT-BROKEN — Verse-level Fisher-Rao fractal

**[[h-new-127-verse-fisher-rao-fractal|H-NEW-127]]** — 4 of 5 pre-registered surahs (Q 2, Q 7, Q 12, Q 36) show verse-level Fisher-Rao optimality (z = −2.82 to −10.26, all p ≤ 0.0046 at Bonferroni-5 threshold 0.01). The fifth surah Q 55 al-Raḥmān REVERSES (canonical order LONGER than 100% of permutations, z = +5.39). This is attributable to al-Raḥmān's 31-refrain interleaving structure: any ordering that clusters near-identical refrain verses wins.

**The pre-committed MW-5 positive control (length-sorted must be WORSE than canonical) FAILS** on Q 55 because refrain verses are near-equal in length, so length-sorting accidentally clusters them. Per pre-reg failure-mode clause → **INSTRUMENT-BROKEN verdict**. The 4/5 replication is held in abeyance until an independent test with a surah-specific MW-5 control validates the null construction. **Honest MW-5 discipline: we do not promote 4/5 to PASS when the null is broken on the 5th.**

Q 55 al-Raḥmān extreme LOW-α outlier (residual −0.285, refrain-flattened). Q 34 Sabaʾ extreme HIGH-α outlier (+0.275, diverse Medinan-mixed narrative). First positive muq-axis signal before [[h-new-165-phonological-predictor|H-NEW-165]] landed; both [[h-new-178-alpha-beta-manifold|H-NEW-178]] and [[h-new-165-phonological-predictor|H-NEW-165]] now jointly establish that muq surahs differ from non-muq on measurable compositional features. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-178-alpha-beta-manifold.md`.

The 5/5/10/9/15/29 sub-counts independently reproduce the classical *fawātiḥ al-suwar* census of al-Suyūṭī (*al-Itqān* nawʿ 61) + al-Zarkashī (*al-Burhān*) at QAC precision — VINDICATED. **(b) Complete closer taxonomy — 5 classes:** other 54, command-imperative 30 (over-broad, see finding limits), single-divine-name 16, divine-name-pair 13, exhortation-eschatological 1 (Q 102 *al-naʿīm* singleton). **29 surahs (~25%) end on a divine attribute** — the *fawāṣil* convention quantified. **(c) Strict single-word inclusio: NULL.** Pre-registered direction was observed > null with floor ≥10; **observed N_match = 0** (first-content-word root == last-word root), null mean 0.27, **p = 1.0 under both seeds**.
