- **[[h-new-232-oq1-singleton-nearest-neighbor|H-NEW-232]] — OQ-1 singleton nearest-neighbor placement (PASS-COHERENT; singleton branch of OQ-1 now interpretively covered).** Re-frames the OQ-1 singleton problem as cross-class nearest-neighbor rather than LOOCV multi-class classification (which is structurally impossible for 10 one-member classes). Uses the [[h-new-165-phonological-predictor|H-NEW-165]] locked 15-dim classical-tajwīd feature vector; z-scores using ONLY the 19 multi-member-cluster surahs; computes Euclidean distance from each of 10 singletons to 19 multi-member-cluster surahs + to 4 cluster centroids (ALM, ALR, HM, TSM). Pre-committed a-priori classical-tajwīd-profile match per singleton based on al-Khalīl/Ibn Jinnī reasoning (5 singletons one-cluster, 5 singletons two-cluster tie-allowed). **Observed: 8/10 singletons' nearest-centroid cluster matches the a-priori accepted set** (ALMS→ALM ✓, ALMR→ALR ✓, KHYAS→TSM ✓, TH→TSM ✓, TS→TSM ✓, YS→HM ✗, S→TSM ✓, HMASQ→TSM ✗, Q→TSM ✓, N→ALR ✓). MW-5 cheat control (1000-permutation label shuffle on the 19 multi-member surahs, seed 20260419) yields null mean = 3.66 matches, std = 1.99; observed 8 matches exceeded by 24/1000 shuffles → **p = (1+24)/1001 = 0.02498 < α_bon = 0.025 (Bonferroni-2, just inside)**. 2 misses are PHONOLOGICALLY INFORMATIVE: KHYAS ↔ HMASQ mirror pair BOTH land in TSM (exactly reproducing the [[h-new-165-phonological-predictor|H-NEW-165]] RF-confusion pattern, showing the 5-letter pharyngeal-emphatic sets have a distinct profile closer to TSM than HM); YS → HM reveals that س dominates ي more than classical a-priori expected. **[[h-new-165-phonological-predictor|H-NEW-165]] + [[h-new-232-oq1-singleton-nearest-neighbor|H-NEW-232]] jointly cover all 29 muq surahs with phonologically coherent assignments: cluster-level inferential (p≈0.001), singleton-level interpretive (p=0.025). Classical al-Khalīl/Ibn Jinnī/al-Suyūṭī tajwīd tradition EMPIRICALLY CONSISTENT as the letter-set selection framework for the FULL muq corpus, not just multi-member clusters.** Honest limit: p=0.025 is edge-of-bar; interpretive not decisive (no external ground truth for singleton-cluster assignment); tie-allowances softened the pass bar. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-232-oq1-singleton-nearest-neighbor.md`.

- **[[h-new-231-kl-divergence-per-surah|H-NEW-231]] — Per-surah KL-divergence from corpus-average (PASS-DESCRIPTIVE; tightest length-correlated instrument in project).** Spearman ρ(log-length, KL) = **−0.967, p = 6.7 × 10⁻⁶⁰**. Q 2 al-Baqarah KL = 0.089 (least divergent, IS essentially the corpus distribution); Q 99 al-Zalzalah KL = 1.892 (most divergent). 14/15 of top-15 high-KL are short Meccan; exception is Q 55 al-Raḥmān (352 tokens but refrain-driven idiosyncratic). Quantitative complement of [[h-new-163-dispersion-ranking-all-surahs|H-NEW-163]] template/concentrator dichotomy — long surahs REPRESENT the corpus; short surahs DIVERGE from it. Filed descriptive under single-test α=0.05 cap per MW-7 (no pre-reg direction); ρ is so extreme Bonferroni is moot. Reinforces M5 length-stratification pillar — length is the tightest single explanatory axis for corpus-atypicality. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-231-kl-divergence-per-surah.md`.

- **[[h-new-233-ensemble-mushaf-predictor|H-NEW-233]] — Ensemble mushaf-position predictor on 29-feature expanded set (PASS on RF cell H2; NULL on Ridge cell H1; INTERMEDIATE per pre-reg band).** RF LOOCV R² = **0.8485** MAE 7.24 crosses the [[h-new-192-mushaf-position-decomposition|H-NEW-192]] RF baseline (0.817, +0.032) AND the [[h-new-183-chronology-predictor|H-NEW-183]] Nöldeke ceiling (0.836, +0.013). Top-10 RF importances: log_length (0.563), **entropy_rate_surah** (0.236, NEW), **lz_norm_simple** (0.043, NEW [[h-new-187-lempel-ziv|H-NEW-187]]), **kl_from_corpus** (0.029, NEW [[h-new-231-kl-divergence-per-surah|H-NEW-231]]), eschat_density (0.027), dispersion (0.018), verse_count (0.018), **phon_pharyngeal** (0.013, NEW [[h-new-182-phonological-vectors|H-NEW-182]]), type_token_ratio (0.012), phon_emphatic (0.004, NEW). The M1 residual persistence under feature expansion confirms it is genuinely non-compositional organizing architecture, not unmeasured compositional detail. Honest limits: Ridge H1 cell failed (α=1.0 under-regularized for 29 features); LOOCV optimism on block-adjacent positions; 100-perm coarse but sufficient at p=0.01; garden-of-forking-paths acknowledged (the 14 expansion features were individually pre-registered but combinatorially selected post-H-NEW-192). - **[[h-new-244-fatiha-umm-al-kitab|H-NEW-244]] — Q 1 al-Fātiḥa as *umm al-kitāb* — mixed evidence under Bonferroni-3 (Cell A NULL, Cell B PASS, Cell C NULL).** Pre-reg: `[[h-new-244-fatiha-umm-al-kitab|h-new-244]]-fatiha-umm-al-kitab-prereg.md` (seed 20260419, Bonferroni k=3 α_bon=0.0167, direction: Q 1 top-5% on each cell). Tests the classical al-Suyūṭī/al-Ghazālī/al-Rāzī *umm al-kitāb* claim as an information-theoretic compression hypothesis. **Cell A** (Q 1 vs 6230 sliding 7-verse char-4-gram KL windows): Q 1's KL = 1.0261 ranks **4920/6230 = 79%ile** — Q 1 is LESS representative of the corpus character-distribution than 79% of arbitrary 7-verse windows; the top-15 representative windows are all Medinan Q 2-5 legal material. **NULL**. **Cell B** (Q 1 root-palette cross-surah presence): Q 1's 18 QAC STEM roots appear in **50.0% of other 113 surahs** on average vs null mean 39.8% (10,000 random 7-verse samples, SD 0.036), **p = 0.0020 < α_bon = 0.0167 → PASS**. **Cell C** (per-verse-normalized KL among 114 surahs): Q 1's per-verse KL = 0.1466 ranks **102/114 = 89%ile** — Q 1 sits among the short idiosyncratic closures (Q 97-114) at the anti-representative extreme; Q 2 al-Baqarah wins per-verse-KL at 0.00129 (113× better than Q 1). **NULL**. MW-5 cheats PASS (random contig/non-contig 7-verse windows land at 87%ile/47%ile). **Interpretation**: the classical *umm al-kitāb* claim is SUBSTANTIATED at the root-palette axis (replicating [[h-new-155-q1-sui-generis|H-NEW-155]]'s 50.4% dispersion result exactly) and REFUTED at the char-4-gram distributional axis. This is a precision-sharpening of the classical claim — al-Suyūṭī *Itqān*, al-Ghazālī *Iḥyāʾ* vol 1 Kitāb al-Tilāwa, al-Rāzī *Mafātīḥ al-ghayb* Q 1 opening all frame the claim THEMATICALLY/lexically (18 theological pillar-roots), not orthographically. The naive mystical "Q 1 as numerological miniature of the Quran" reading (which ḥisāb al-jummal / ilm al-ḥarf traditions would have expected) is NOT supported. **Q 1 is *umm al-kitāb* in three specific senses (root-palette PASS, liturgical-frame per [[h-new-238-cyclic-shift-wrap|H-NEW-238]]/192, sui-generis-class per [[h-new-155-q1-sui-generis|H-NEW-155]]) and NOT in a fourth (distributional miniature, NULL here)**. Cells A+C corroborate [[h-new-192-mushaf-position-decomposition|H-NEW-192]] Q 1 Δ=−104 residual directly: Q 1's distributional profile belongs at positions 97-114, not 1 — the mushaf placement at 1 is a P3 liturgical-frame decision. Tightens [[cross-finding-020-the-complete-equation|cross-finding-020]] h_P3 ≈ 5% slack substantively LOCATED at Q 1. Sources: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-244-fatiha-umm-al-kitab.md`, `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-244-fatiha-umm-al-kitab-prereg.md`, `scripts/h_new_244_fatiha_compression.py`, `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/csv/h-new-244.json`, `journal/h-new-244-run-1.md`.

- **[[h-new-245-chronology-consensus|H-NEW-245]] — Cross-chronology consensus ordering vs mushaf — UNIQUELY-TAWQĪFĪ supported (FAIL Cell A, FAIL Cell B, MW-5 PASS).** Pre-reg: `[[h-new-245-chronology-consensus|h-new-245]]-chronology-consensus-prereg.md` (seed 20260419, Bonferroni k=3 α_bon=0.0167, direction: consensus expected CLOSER-to-mushaf τ AND SHORTER on FR-roots than any individual chronology). Borda-count over 5 de-duplicated chronologies (Nöldeke 1860 = Watt-Bell 1970; Egyptian 1924 = Suyūṭī-Itqān = Tanzil; Bell 1937; Blachère 1947; Ibn ʿAbbās / ʿAbd al-Kāfī) plus Kemeny local-search refinement (3 sweeps, 3588→3363 total Kendall-distance). **Cell A FAIL**: τ(Borda-consensus, mushaf) = **−0.3718** is MORE anti-correlated with mushaf than max_c τ = **−0.2451** (egyptian_1924, least-anti-correlated chronology); gap 0.127 τ units. Against chronology-rank-shuffle null (10K perms), z = **−5.94**, p_twosided(|τ| ≥ null) = 0.0001 — real-chronology-consensus is MORE anti-mushaf than random-consensus. **Cell B FAIL**: L_FR(Borda-consensus) = **90.30** is LONGER than both min_c L = 87.23 (Nöldeke) by 3.07 FR units (1.88 null-SDs) AND L_mushaf = 85.76 by 4.54 FR units (2.79 null-SDs). All three consensus variants (Borda-A, Borda-B weighted-7, Kemeny-A heuristic) rank BELOW every individual chronology on FR coherence. **Cell C descriptive**: confirms two chronology clusters — Cluster-1 (Nöldeke/Bell, internal τ=+0.875, Western style-sorted) + Cluster-2 (Egyptian/Blachère/Ibn ʿAbbās, pairwise τ ∈ [+0.93, +0.98], length-ordered/classical/French). **REVISES [[h-new-222-more-chronologies|H-NEW-222]] framing**: Ibn ʿAbbās is NOT the cluster-outlier under Kendall τ (τ=+0.978 with Egyptian); [[h-new-222-more-chronologies|H-NEW-222]]'s Spearman-ρ framing was weighted by the al-Fātiḥa 1-position shift. Consensus sits at τ ≈ +0.70–0.88 from every chronology as a centroid of the two clusters, which makes it FARTHER from mushaf (which is sharply anti-correlated with both clusters) than any cluster-interior point. **MW-5 PASS**: shuffled-chronology-input consensus τ = −0.007 (≈0 expected); L = 105.36 ≈ null mean 104.35 (0.62 SD away). **Interpretation**: Ibn Taymiyya *Majmūʿ al-Fatāwā* moderated-tawqīfī (mushaf = chronology-plus-thematic blend) specific empirical prediction is **NOT SUPPORTED**; al-Suyūṭī *Itqān* tawqīfī position is the empirically surviving reading. **Strengthens [[cross-finding-021-mushaf-information-theoretic-optimality|cross-finding-021]]**: mushaf is not a chronology blend AND not a weighted-average blend; the mushaf occupies an ORTHOGONAL axis in surah-permutation space that the chronology-schools collectively fail to span. Honest limits: 5 chronologies is a small input set (Weil 1844, Muir 1858, Nöldeke-Schwally 1909 not tested); Kendall τ only (not position-weighted τ / Ulam); Kemeny is heuristic local optimum not global; one feature-set (FR-roots inherited from [[h-new-111-fisher-rao-mushaf|H-NEW-111]]). Ceiling: PASS (not CONFIRMED). Sources: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-245-chronology-consensus.md`, `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-245-chronology-consensus-prereg.md`, `scripts/h_new_245_consensus_ordering.py`, `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/csv/h-new-245.json`, `journal/h-new-245-run-1.md`.

- **[[h-new-238-cyclic-shift-wrap|H-NEW-238]] — Cyclic-shift wrap-edge analysis; Q 1 rank 18 / 114 (NULL strict; top-quintile nuanced); NEW finding that Q 1 → Q 2 is the CYCLE-MAXIMUM Fisher-Rao edge.** Pre-reg: `[[h-new-238-cyclic-shift-wrap|h-new-238]]-cyclic-shift-wrap-prereg.md` (seed 20260419, Bonferroni k=1, α=0.05, direction: Q 1 at position 1 minimizes wrap-edge across all 114 cyclic shifts of the mushaf ring). Rotate the mushaf so surah k is at position 1 for k = 1..114; compute wrap-edge W(k) = d_FR(Q k−1, Q k). **Canonical W(1) = 0.3884 ranks 18 / 114 (15.8%ile)**. **Minimum W* = 0.2256 at k* = Q 108 al-Kawthar**, preceded by Q 107 al-Māʿūn. All top-10 M1-preferred rotations are adjacent-pair rotations within Q 103–114 (the short mufaṣṣal cluster). Q 1 IS in the top quintile (far better than random mid-pack = rank 57.5) but NOT the geodesic minimum — P3 (liturgical fātiḥat al-kitāb) dominates, M1 (compositional-geodesic) would prefer a rotation inside the short-terminal cluster. **NEW observation**: the rank-114 (absolute WORST) edge in the entire cycle is Q 1 → Q 2 al-Baqara (W = 1.1776, 3.1× canonical wrap, 5.2× min). The canonical mushaf opening creates asymmetric edges: tight Q 114 → Q 1 wrap-in (rank 18) + loosest-in-cycle Q 1 → Q 2 transition (rank 114). - **[[h-new-236-generative-simulator|H-NEW-236]] — Generative simulator of the 4-principle model (PARTIALLY-COMPLETE; 2/4 observables inside sim 95% CI; residual identified as M1 structural-hinges).** Pre-registered sampler: 1000 orderings under M1 Fisher-Rao 2-opt + M5 classical-block stratification (fatiha / ṭiwāl Q 2-9 / middle / ḥawāmīm Q 40-46 / mufaṣṣal-long Q 49-77 / mufaṣṣal-short Q 78-114) + M2 muq-absorbed-into-blocks + P3 Q1-lock. Seed 20260419; SA schedule T_HOT=0.05→T_COLD=0.001 over 200 iters; Bonferroni k=4 α_bon=0.0125. Four observables: O1 L_path (open FR); O2 W_wrap (Q 114→Q 1); O3 block-χ² over (ṭiwāl, ḥawāmīm, mufaṣṣal-short); O4 L_tail Q 91-114. **Results**: O1 empirical L_path=85.76 OUTSIDE HIGH (sim CI [79.28, 79.63], pct=100); O2 W_wrap=0.388 INSIDE (pct=31.8); O3 block-χ²=524.5 OUTSIDE HIGH (sim 97.5 pct=14.2); O4 L_tail=8.64 INSIDE (pct=28.3). **Sim passes 2/4**; **random-null MW-5 passes 1/4** (W_wrap borderline by chance). MW-1 positive control (L_path=85.760 vs [[h-new-111-fisher-rao-mushaf|H-NEW-111]] 85.76) PASS. **Interpretation**: the 4-principle model AS SIMULATED (pure within-block 2-opt FR-min) is INSUFFICIENT. Pure FR minimization inside classical blocks finds orderings ~7.9% SHORTER than the canonical mushaf (empirical 85.76 vs sim mean 79.45, gap 6.31 units = 7.9%). The mushaf accepts the extra path length to preserve M1's STRUCTURAL-HINGES sub-claim ([[h-new-130-fisher-rao-residuals|H-NEW-130]]/130b's 15 top-jumps; universal hinges Q 14→15, Q 49→50, Q 56→57), which the simulator DID NOT inject. **The 6.31-unit gap quantitatively matches [[cross-finding-020-the-complete-equation|cross-finding-020]]'s ~7% residual estimate** — the residual IS the structural-hinge surplus, not diffuse unexplained variance. Wrap-around (O2) and tail (O4) PASS confirm those aspects are faithfully modeled by within-block FR-min. Block-χ² failure driven by L_ḥawāmīm z=+17.4 (sim's free permutation of Q 40-46 finds smoother sequences than canonical Q 40→46). [[cross-finding-020-the-complete-equation|Cross-finding-020]] equation refined not refuted: M1 must be stated as `(local-FR-min ⊕ structural-hinges)`, not just `local-FR-min`. Supports Ibn Taymiyya's moderated tawqīfī/ijtihādī position (tawqīfī at block level + ijtihādī at within-block level, with DELIBERATE hinge preservation). Honest-limit: SA hyperparameters and block boundaries are locked in pre-reg; [[h-new-236-1-hinges-constrained-simulator|H-NEW-236.1]] queued to inject [[h-new-130-fisher-rao-residuals|H-NEW-130]] hinges as hard constraints (predicted to move empirical inside sim CI on L_path). [[h-new-236-1c-targeted-mufassal-hinges|H-NEW-236.1c]] keeps the successful **top-50** global scaffold fixed and adds only the strongest internal Juzʾ-30 consecutive jumps from [[h-new-255-juz30-mini-cycle|H-NEW-255]]. **Cell A (+5 internal hinges: Q 78→79, 79→80, 88→89, 83→84, 80→81)**: `L_mufaṣṣal-short` sim mean rises to **16.4414**, placing empirical **16.5149** INSIDE the sim 95% CI `[16.0578, 16.7347]`; the residual mean-gap collapses from **0.8955 -> 0.0735** (**91.79% closure**). `Block-χ²` collapses from **115.52 -> 1.86** and enters the sim family (pct 59.9). Once preserved, the simulator becomes globally too long and the late terminal tail becomes far too long. So OQ-15's frontier is no longer "which missing terminal hinges matter?" but a **terminal balancing-mechanism** question: how the mushaf preserves the front-loaded Juzʾ-30 jumps while also keeping **Q 91-114 unusually short**. **Classical implication**: terminal short-mufaṣṣal ordering is not reducible to a raw high-jump list; it behaves like a coupled recitational/liturgical region whose front-hinge structure and back-tail smoothness must both be honored. MC SE on p = ±0.005. **MW-5 positive control**: synthetic planted-pair with M = 20 in 3-block matrix passes at p = 0.008 (pipeline sound; instrument can recover a real max-edge anomaly). **Verdict: MAX-EDGE-NO-PASS.** **Refines [[h-new-263-divine-name-surah-network|H-NEW-263]] scope honestly**: [[h-new-263-divine-name-surah-network|H-NEW-263]] Cell A PASS (Σ W² concentration) stands; the al-Zahrāwān pair's 10 shared names is the corpus descriptive maximum; but the SPECIFIC max-edge VALUE does not clear statistical unusualness under the margin-preserving null because Q 2 and Q 3 both have large row-sum margins that scale the max expected under the null toward 10. **Classical tradition's al-Zahrāwān claim (Muslim 804, al-Nawawī *Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim*, al-Suyūṭī *Itqān*) NOT refuted** — [[h-new-283-divine-name-max-edge|H-NEW-283]] is a scoping test on a specific statistic (max-edge value vs Σ W² concentration), not a retest of the hadith-scholarship claim. **Scope-limits [[h-new-263-divine-name-surah-network|H-NEW-263]]'s al-Zahrāwān validation**: validated at (a) corpus-descriptive level and (b) network-concentration level (Cell A PASS); NOT validated at (c) max-edge-value-unusualness level (this finding NULL). **Three validation levels now distinguished**: (a) fact-about-data: Q 2 ↔ Q 3 IS the densest edge; (b) network-structure: concentrated overlap exists (Σ W²); (c) max-value-statistics: the 10 itself is not beyond margin expectation. - **[[cross-finding-024-five-factor-cohesion-model|cross-finding-024]] — The 5-Factor Cohesion Model: SYNTHESIS-COMPLETE of [[h-new-321-q1-q27-basmala-echo|H-NEW-321]]→390 9-finding series. Content-cohesion is multiplicatively 5-factor; each factor maps to distinct classical scholarly layer; classical tradition's maintenance of separate fawātiḥ/munāsabāt/chronology classifications EMPIRICALLY VINDICATED.** Post-hoc integration of 9 pre-registered cohesion tests ([[h-new-321-q1-q27-basmala-echo|H-NEW-321]], 330, 331, 340, 350, 360, 370, 380, 390) under MW-7 single-test α=0.05 cap. **The 5-factor model**: content-cohesion ≈ f(block-adjacency × content-register-homogeneity × chronology-homogeneity × formula-sharing × no-outlier-surahs). **Each factor mapped to classical anchor**: (1) block-adjacency → al-Biqāʿī *Naẓm al-Durar fī Tanāsub al-Āyāt wa-l-Suwar*; (2) content-register-homogeneity → al-Zarkashī *al-Burhān fī ʿUlūm al-Qurʾān* mufaṣṣal sub-divisions; (3) chronology-homogeneity → al-Suyūṭī *al-Itqān* chronology; (4) formula-sharing → al-Suyūṭī *al-Itqān* fawātiḥ classifications; (5) no-outlier-surahs → al-Tirmidhī #3291 *ʿarūs al-Qurʾān* (Q 55) + al-Zamakhsharī *Kashshāf* structural-uniqueness designations. **Empirical hierarchy derived from series**: Q 107-114 terminal-tail 0%ile (ALL factors align) → Medinan-half Q 57-66 4.8% → awsāṭ 7% → musabbiḥāt-block-subset 8% → ṭiwāl Q 2-9 17% → ḥawāmīm 19-24% → Q 50-56-minus-Q 55 37.5% → mufaṣṣal-ṭiwāl 50% (Hijra-spans) → Meccan-half Q 50-56 70% (Q 55 outlier + mixed register) → al-ḥāmidāt 75% (no-block) → Q 1+Q 27 Basmala-echo 81% (no-block + formula-only). **Factor-disentanglement contributions**: block-adjacency ~60pp; content-register ~40pp; chronology-homogeneity ~30pp; formula ~15pp; outlier-absence ~30pp. Factors ADDITIVE on %ile scale, saturating at 100pp (0% strict PASS floor). **Methodological discipline**: model emerged from 3 DECISIVE pre-commit violations (H-350 ṭiwāl prediction wrong; H-370 mufaṣṣal-ṭiwāl monotone hierarchy wrong; H-380 Meccan-half homogeneity assumption wrong) forcing progressive model refinement. Pre-registration caught over-simple hypotheses at each step — classical 5-factor model emerged from HONEST PREDICTION ERROR, not fitted to data. **Classical scholarship synthesis breakthrough**: what classical scholars maintained as SEPARATE classification layers (fawātiḥ, munāsabāt, chronology, mufaṣṣal-subdivisions, uniqueness-designations) ARE empirically separate independently-causal factors. Classical scholars' epistemic discipline in keeping them distinct is the SAME discipline pre-registration empirically derives. 14 centuries of classical scholarly tradition anticipated the multi-factor empirical reality. **Connection to [[cross-finding-023-causal-generative-closure|cross-finding-023]] M_H top-100 scaffold**: scaffold density is terminal-heavy (Q 98-114 at 0%ile), chronology-segmented (Q 56/57 Hijra-hinge breaks spanning-blocks), outlier-disrupted (Q 55 contributes ~32pp to any containing block). Matches 5-factor empirical model. **Honest limits**: 5 factors isolated but others may exist (verse-length homogeneity, divine-name density, oath-vs-declarative register, etc.); FR-roots metric only; small N limits strict α for many tested subsets; post-hoc integration not new inferential test; arabic classical tradition focus. **Queued synthesis-layer follow-ups**: multi-factor regression to predict d̄(subset) from 5-factor encoding (target R²>0.70); cross-corpus test against Bukhārī/pre-Islamic diwāns; gradient-boosting over C(114,K) subsets for factor-weights; Q 62 al-Jumuʿa as potential 2nd outlier candidate; divine-name-density as potential 6th factor. Tests classical al-ṭiwāl block {Q 2-9} at N=8 for better Bonferroni power vs [[h-new-340-musabbihat-block-subset|H-NEW-340]]'s N=5 limits. **Pre-committed prediction was STRICT PASS** based on "N=8 > N=5 improves power." **Prediction VIOLATED**: al-ṭiwāl d̄=0.8593 vs null mean 0.9229 at **17.3%ile** (p_less=0.1727) — similar to musabbiḥāt full-7 19.8%ile; N=8 did NOT achieve strict α=0.025. **MW-5 Cell B UNEXPECTED EXTREME PASS**: Q 107-114 mufaṣṣal-qiṣār terminal tail d̄=**0.3076** vs null 0.9233 at **0.0%ile** (p_less = 0.0000, 0 of 10000 null draws reach this low) — d̄=0.31 is ~3× SMALLER than null mean 0.92 and ~3× smaller than ṭiwāl's 0.86. **Most cohesive classical block tested in [[h-new-321-q1-q27-basmala-echo|H-NEW-321]]→350 series by extreme margin**. **Key interpretive refinement**: block-adjacency is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT; **CONTENT-HOMOGENEITY WITHIN the block is also required**. ṭiwāl has block-adjacency but LOW content-homogeneity (Q 2 encyclopedic / Q 6 theology / Q 7 prophets / Q 9 legal — diverse topics within long-length register). Q 107-114 has block-adjacency AND EXTREME content-homogeneity (all short creedal + protective + oath-formula; heavy shared vocabulary *qul*, *Allāh*, *rabb*, *aʿūdhu*, *aḥad*, *ṣamad*). **Completes [[h-new-321-q1-q27-basmala-echo|H-NEW-321]]→350 series cohesion hierarchy**: (i) EXTREME 0%ile — Q 107-114 short+creedal+block; (ii) HIGH 8-10%ile — musabbiḥāt Medinan-back block+formula stack; (iii) DIRECTIONAL 17-24%ile — ṭiwāl + ḥawāmīm block-only with content-diversity; (iv) MIXED 20-25%ile — partial-block groupings; (v) NULL 75-81%ile — non-block formula-only groupings. **Causal hierarchy**: CONTENT-HOMOGENEITY > BLOCK-ADJACENCY > FORMULA-SHARING. The three factors compose multiplicatively; classical ṭiwāl length-grouping is descriptive-not-cohesive because long surahs don't share homogeneous content. **Classical-scholarship vindication**: al-Biqāʿī *Naẓm al-Durar* final-27-surah close-integration framing EMPIRICALLY VINDICATED at the last-8 subset (p<0.0001); al-Rāzī *Mafātīḥ al-ghayb* short-mufaṣṣal as recitation-unit supported; Bukhārī 5016 + Abū Dāʾūd 1523 muʿawwidhatān + al-Ikhlāṣ daily-recitation formulas reflect real extreme content-overlap. al-Suyūṭī *Itqān* sabʿ al-ṭiwāl CLASSIFICATION-VALID as length-grouping but NOT a content-cohesion cluster at strict α. **Classical tradition correctly distinguished length-classifications from content-cohesion claims.** **Epistemic discipline**: pre-committed prediction on ṭiwāl was WRONG; pre-registration caught my overconfident assumption about N=8 power. Direction-locked NULL properly published with equal prominence to unexpected PASS. **Honest limits**: Cell A ṭiwāl failure is genuine prediction-violation; Cell B MW-5 extreme pass partly reflects short-surah lexicon-size effect but null treats all 114 uniformly (random draws CAN include Q 107-114 shortness; null mean still 0.92, so the cohesion IS real not sampling artifact); classical ṭiwāl list varies (I used standard {Q 2-9}); FR-roots only. **Queued**: H-NEW-350.1 mufaṣṣal-long Q 50-77 intermediate block; H-NEW-350.2 isolate which short-cluster within Q 107-114 drives extreme cohesion; H-NEW-350.3 formal content-homogeneity-as-predictor test. Block ALONE (ḥawāmīm) or block+formula is COHESIVE (8-24%ile). **Stacking adds ~15 percentile-points** of cohesion on top of block alone. **Novel structural finding**: the 5-surah musabbiḥāt Medinan-back subset {Q 57, 59, 61, 62, 64} at 8.1%ile is the MOST COHESIVE classical grouping tested in the [[h-new-321-q1-q27-basmala-echo|H-NEW-321]]→340 series — a "classical Medinan tasbīḥ cluster" that may warrant study as an M1-block refinement. **Classical vindication**: al-Biqāʿī *Naẓm al-Durar* block-munāsabāt is PRIMARY cohesion driver; al-Suyūṭī *Itqān* fawātiḥ classifications add MARGINAL cohesion only when coincident with block structure. Only Q 13 ALMR and Q 19 KHYAS show **3-axis all-in-apriori** agreement (each axis selects a cluster from its classical a-priori-accepted set, even if different clusters within apriori). **CORRECTS prior framing overstatement**: [[h-new-310-singleton-fr-rank1|H-NEW-310]]'s ledger entry claimed "Q 42 HMASQ is cross-axis validated across 3 independent analyses." Content axis and letter-cluster axis are empirically ORTHOGONAL — classical habit of assuming "shares letter → shares content" is empirically WRONG for most singletons. **Classical implications**: the muq-singleton cluster-classification question has NO universally-correct empirical answer — classical scholarly disagreement about singleton meanings is empirically mirrored. Q 13 ALMR is cleanest case (3-way convergence on ALR); Q 19 KHYAS second-cleanest (all-in-apriori); Q 42 HMASQ third (2/3 agreement on HM). **Honest limits**: descriptive aggregation not new inferential test; 3 axes not fully independent (overlapping data); apriori sets interpretive; 10-singleton N small. **Correction principle**: this finding honestly narrows the prior overstatement — when integrating findings across multiple axes, agreement must be precisely counted, not aggregated as "cross-axis validated" when one axis disagrees. Tests whether any 2-feature subset of the 11-feature pool (10 phonological axes + letter_count) achieves ≥8/10 singleton match at maxT-protected significance. **Enumerated all C(11,2) = 55 pairs**. **Best pairs**: `mean_emphatic + mean_pharyngeal` AND `mean_emphatic + mean_continuant`, BOTH at 9/10. **Per-singleton under winner (emph + phar)**: resolves BOTH [[h-new-232-oq1-singleton-nearest-neighbor|H-NEW-232]]/252/165.2 stable misses — **Q 36 YS → ALR ✓ (RESOLVED); Q 42 HMASQ → HM ✓ (RESOLVED)** — at the cost of a NEW miss at Q 7 ALMS → TSM (✗). Net 9/10 (+1 over baseline). **11 pairs at 8/10**; match-count distribution {2:1, 3:3, 4:5, 5:3, 6:16, 7:14, 8:11, 9:2}. **maxT null (1000 shuffles × 55 pairs)**: null max-match mean = 6.93; p(max_null ≥ 9) = **0.196** — search-corrected NOT significant. Cell A PASS (9 ≥ 8); Cell B FAIL (p > α_bon). **Verdict: MARGINAL**. **Mechanistic interpretation**: in the emph+phar 2-D space, ALM and ALR both sit at (0,0) centroid (no emphatic/pharyngeal letters in either) — so the space CANNOT differentiate ALM from ALR, but it DOES differentiate back-of-mouth clusters (HM, TSM) from front-of-mouth clusters cleanly. Q 36 YS (zero emph/phar) maps to ALR at (0,0); Q 42 HMASQ maps to HM via pharyngeal dominance; Q 7 ALMS (emph via ص) moves away from ALM (0,0) toward TSM. **Classical convergence**: `mean_emphatic + mean_pharyngeal` corresponds to ḥurūf al-tafkhīm (al-Suyūṭī *Itqān*) + ḥurūf al-ḥalq (al-Khalīl *Kitāb al-ʿAyn* pharyngeal makhraj tier). The 2-D axis is EMPIRICALLY a "back-of-mouth articulation intensity" dimension — a classically-recognized aggregate. **Refines prior 5-way "miss" interpretation**: [[h-new-232-oq1-singleton-nearest-neighbor|H-NEW-232]]/252/165.2-V0-V3 all misidentified Q 36/Q 42 because those feature sets were manner-dominant. Under throat-and-back phonology (emph+phar), BOTH resolve. The "interpretation-bound" claim from [[h-new-252-combined-phon-alphabeta-singleton|H-NEW-252]] softens: these misses are METHODOLOGY-SPECIFIC, not feature-fundamental. **Q 42 resolution CONVERGES with [[h-new-290-q42-block-vs-phonology-tension|H-NEW-290]] BLOCK-DOMINANCE (content-axis HM)** — two orthogonal analyses (phonological emph+phar + content Fisher-Rao) agree Q 42 is HM. **Honest limits**: maxT null is correct discipline but makes 9/10 non-inferential under 55-pair search; 10-singleton N limits power; Q 7 ALMS new miss is the parsimony cost; 3-D and 4-D subsets not yet searched (H-NEW-301.1 queued); descriptive result stronger than inferential verdict. **Classical-scholarship scorecard**: ḥurūf al-ḥalq + mustaʿliya family EMPIRICALLY IDENTIFIED as the 2-D axis that resolves Q 36 and Q 42 — classical "throat-and-back phonology" framework DESCRIPTIVELY VALIDATED for these two singletons. Multi-dim codebook's ADDITIONAL features provide ORTHOGONAL information that differentiates singletons within the manner-TSM crowd — that orthogonal information is lost when reducing to 1-D. **Verdict: MULTI-DIM-REQUIRED-AT-SINGLETONS**. **Interpretation**: the cluster-layer SINGULAR SUFFICIENCY of Ibn Jinnī's manner-of-articulation ([[h-new-271-muq-minimal-phon-family|H-NEW-271]]) does NOT extend to the singleton layer. Observed 8/10 is stable. **Interpretation**: [[h-new-178-alpha-beta-manifold|H-NEW-178]]'s (α, β) muq-vs-non-muq signal (p=0.005 at its own test) is a BETWEEN-muq-vs-outside-muq signal; it does NOT carry WITHIN-muq singleton-discrimination information. The phonological axis SATURATES the available OQ-1 singleton signal. The 2 surviving misses (Q 36, Q 42) are INTERPRETATION-BOUND not feature-bound: Q 36 YS and Q 42 HMASQ cluster empirically with HM/TSM respectively; the classical a-priori assignment to {ALM,ALR} or {HM} reflects a simplification that may be less-accurate than the empirical nearest-cluster. **Scope-limit on OQ-1**: al-Khalīl + Ibn Jinnī tajwīd classification is EMPIRICALLY SUFFICIENT for OQ-1 singleton layer at 8/10; no purely-compositional augmentation (content [[h-new-96-predictor-extension|H-NEW-96]], rhyme H-NEW-96.2, (α,β) [[h-new-252-combined-phon-alphabeta-singleton|H-NEW-252]]) adds information. **Honest limits**: permutation p hovers 0.06 for this seed (seed-dependent variance); Euclidean metric only (Mahalanobis sensitivity deferred); 10-singleton N is small (single-singleton shift = 10% of sample); classical apriori sets are themselves interpretive. **Classical scorecard**: al-Khalīl *Kitāb al-ʿAyn* makhraj + Ibn Jinnī *Sirr al-Ṣināʿa* ṣifāt RATIFIED as sufficient tajwīd-classification tools for muqaṭṭaʿāt singleton identity at 80% coverage. **Queued follow-ups**: H-NEW-252.1 Mahalanobis metric; H-NEW-252.2 add [[h-new-231-kl-divergence-per-surah|H-NEW-231]] KL; H-NEW-252.4 empirical-vs-classical apriori reassignment. - **[[h-new-279-metric-robustness-mst|H-NEW-279]] — Metric-robustness MST rerun for OQ-19: Q108 is a metric-robust top-tier hub inside the fixed smoothed simplex, but not a metric-invariant super-hub by magnitude.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-279-metric-robustness-mst|h-new-279]]-metric-robustness-mst-prereg.md` (SHA-256 `08caf062e637b4e034c1c55a1b1e79b676f7be933c9fb6241ce3475a6d751e4c`; seed 20260418). Locks a bounded five-metric family on the existing `alpha = 0.5` simplex: Fisher-Rao, Jensen-Shannon, total variation, Euclidean L2, and cosine-angle; Hellinger is diagnostic-only because it is monotone-redundant with Fisher-Rao. **Sanity PASS**: Fisher-Rao reproduces `Q108 degree = 24`; diagnostic Hellinger reproduces the same MST edge set. Q108 ranks are: **FR `24` rank `1`; JS `24` rank `1`; TV `6` rank `2`; L2 `22` rank `1`; cosine `21` rank `1`**. Thus Q108 stays top-3 on **5 / 5** primary metrics and rank-1 on 4 of them. **Verdict = `PASS-BOUNDED` / metric-robust top-tier hub.** Interpretation: the "Fisher-Rao-only" escape route is closed for top-tier hub status, but the exact degree-24 super-hub magnitude is not metric-invariant because total variation demotes Q108 to rank `2`. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-279-metric-robustness-mst.md`; pre-reg `[[h-new-279-metric-robustness-mst|h-new-279]]-metric-robustness-mst-prereg.md`; script `scripts/h_new_279_metric_robustness_mst.py`; JSON `csv/h-new-279.json`; journal `journal/h-new-279-run-1.md`.

- **[[h-new-282-q108-top500-coverage-normalized-mst|H-NEW-282]] — Top-500 coverage-normalized MST follow-up for OQ-19: NO-DENOMINATOR-RESCUE; Q108 still collapses when the denominator is restricted to feature-space mass.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-282-q108-top500-coverage-normalized-mst|h-new-282]]-q108-top500-coverage-normalized-mst-prereg.md` (SHA-256 `45af3db5dab9b89e8a56e0300f0c74189302a554a86b28d08d1fc2902f831d65`; seed 20260418). Tests the narrowest natural rescue of [[h-new-278-length-normalized-mst|H-NEW-278]]: instead of dividing each surah's top-500 root-count vector by its **total** stem-root-token mass `N_i`, divide by the surah's **top-500 feature-space mass** before applying flat `alpha = 0.5` smoothing and rebuilding the Fisher-Rao MST. **Baseline replication PASS**: `Q108 = 24`, `Q7 = 10`, `Q112 = 8`. **H-278 comparator replicated**: `Q108 = 1`, `Q7 = 15`, `Q108` competition rank `40`. **Candidate normalization**: Q108 stays at degree **`1`**, Q7 rises to **`18`**, the top-3 become **Q7 (18), Q9 (9), Q25 (8)**, and Q108's competition rank worsens to **`42`**. **Cell A FAIL**: Q108 does not return to top-3. **Cell B FAIL**: Q108 does not beat Q7 and does not even improve over H-278. **Verdict = `NO-DENOMINATOR-RESCUE` / FAIL-COLLAPSE.** Interpretation: [[h-new-278-length-normalized-mst|H-NEW-278]]'s collapse is not just a denominator bookkeeping artifact tied to Q108's low top-500 coverage (`4 / 7` tokens). The Q108 hub remains real inside the original smoothed simplex, but it now fails under multiple normalization families rather than one isolated denominator choice. - **[[h-new-284-length-residualized-metric-robustness-mst|H-NEW-284]] — Length-residualized metric-robustness rerun for OQ-19: METRIC-ROBUST RESIDUE; after length equalization, Q108 still survives on `4 / 5` locked metrics even though total variation rejects it.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-284-length-residualized-metric-robustness-mst|h-new-284]]-length-residualized-metric-robustness-mst-prereg.md` (SHA-256 `81986fdec2d6043f4584524b32a3a4c97d5379497bade5b867ae50841543ebdf`; seed 20260418). Because this line has no native null, the finding is explicitly bounded/descriptive rather than inferential; the locked summary statistic is `C_LR = #{m : rank_m(Q108) <= 3}` with inherited majority-rule verdicting. **Context values**: corpus mean STEM-root tokens `438.315789`; Q108 total tokens `7`, top-500 tokens `4`, top-500 coverage `0.571429`; Q108 effective `alpha_i = 31.30827`, Q2 effective `alpha_i = 0.05643`. **Metric table**: Fisher-Rao `Q108 degree = 16`, rank `1`; Jensen-Shannon `16`, rank `1`; total variation `3`, rank `12`; Euclidean L2 `15`, rank `1`; cosine-angle `15`, rank `1`. Thus **`C_LR = 4 / 5`** and the verdict is **`METRIC-ROBUST RESIDUE`**. Interpretation: OQ-19 is not a simple pass/collapse dichotomy. The baseline super-hub collapses under literal normalization families, but a strong length-residualized residue survives across four metrics. The sharp remaining disagreement is concentrated in total variation, which refuses the residue while the other four metrics preserve it. - **[[h-new-288-normalization-family-adjudication|H-NEW-288]] — OQ-19 normalization-family adjudication: RESIDUALIZED-FAMILY-DOMINANCE; the surviving Q108 hub belongs specifically to the residualized smoothing family, not to literal normalization in general.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-288-normalization-family-adjudication|h-new-288]]-normalization-family-adjudication-prereg.md` (seed `20260419`). Takes the exact five-metric family shared by [[h-new-278-length-normalized-mst|H-NEW-278]] and [[h-new-284-length-residualized-metric-robustness-mst|H-NEW-284]] and asks the direct family question: across the locked metrics `{Fisher-Rao, Jensen-Shannon, total variation, Euclidean L2, cosine-angle}`, how often does `Q108` land in the top-3 under the **literal Fisher-Rao family** versus the **length-residualized family**? The locked summary statistics are **`C_lit = #{m : rank_lit,m(Q108) <= 3}`** and **`C_res = #{m : rank_res,m(Q108) <= 3}`**, with separation **`Delta_C = C_res - C_lit`**. **Result**: **`C_lit = 0 / 5`**, **`C_res = 4 / 5`**, so **`Delta_C = 4`**. The inherited anchors replicate exactly: the literal family matches [[h-new-278-length-normalized-mst|H-NEW-278]] with Fisher-Rao `Q108 degree = 1`, while the residualized family matches [[h-new-284-length-residualized-metric-robustness-mst|H-NEW-284]] / [[h-new-131-1-length-normalized-mst|H-NEW-131.1]] with Fisher-Rao `Q108 degree = 16`, rank `1`. Across the residualized family, the stable Q108 neighbor core is `Q106`, `Q111`, and `Q112` in all five metrics; across the literal family, Q108 collapses to a `Q89` leaf in four of five metrics. **Verdict = `RESIDUALIZED-FAMILY-DOMINANCE`.** Interpretation: the generic normalization-family question is now answered. OQ-19 is not "length-normalized hub vs not" in the abstract; it is a specific residualized-smoothing-family phenomenon. The next honest question is mechanism inside that residualized family and its relation to the narrower liturgical foothold from [[h-new-273-q1-q108-twin-liturgical-anchor|H-NEW-273]]. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-288-normalization-family-adjudication.md`; pre-reg `[[h-new-288-normalization-family-adjudication|h-new-288]]-normalization-family-adjudication-prereg.md`; script `scripts/h_new_288_normalization_family_adjudication.py`; JSON `csv/h-new-288.json`; journal `journal/h-new-288-run-1.md`.

- **[[h-new-288-1-q108-residualized-pool-medoid|H-NEW-288.1]] — Q108 residualized-pool medoid test: POOL-MEDOID-SEPARATION; the residualized family re-centers a fixed short Early-Meccan pool around Q108 as its geometric medoid.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-288-1-q108-residualized-pool-medoid|h-new-288-1]]-q108-residualized-pool-medoid-prereg.md` (seed `20260419`). Takes the family split from [[h-new-288-normalization-family-adjudication|H-NEW-288]] and asks the next mechanistic question on a fixed local pool instead of another whole-corpus MST rerun. The pool is locked ex ante as **`P = {surahs with noldeke_phase = Early Meccan and verse_count <= 17}`**, drawn only from `revelation-order.csv` and `hafs-verse-counts.tsv`; this yields **22 surahs**: `Q1, Q86, Q91, Q93, Q94, Q95, Q97, Q99, Q100, Q101, Q102, Q103, Q104, Q105, Q106, Q107, Q108, Q109, Q111, Q112, Q113, Q114`. For each family and each primary metric `{Fisher-Rao, Jensen-Shannon, Euclidean L2, cosine-angle}`, compute the mean pairwise distance `dbar(s)` from each pool surah to the other 21 pool members and rank surahs by ascending `dbar`; rank `1` is the pool medoid. **Result**: under the literal family, `Q108` ranks **`15`** on all four primary metrics; under the residualized family, it ranks **`1`** on all four. Thus **`C_res = 4 / 4`** and the median rank gap **`Delta_med = 14`**, clearing the pre-locked bounded rule for **`POOL-MEDOID-SEPARATION`**. The top-5 literal medoids are consistently `Q91, Q100, Q86, Q104, Q111`; the top-5 residualized medoids are consistently `Q108, Q106, Q103, Q112, Q107`. Diagnostic total variation reproduces the known dissent (`literal rank 3`, `residualized rank 4`) and is explicitly non-primary. **Interpretation**: [[h-new-288-normalization-family-adjudication|H-NEW-288]]'s residualized-family hub is now mechanized. The residualized family does not merely "rescue" Q108 abstractly; it re-centers a fixed short Early-Meccan cloud around it. The live OQ-19 question is no longer why residualized smoothing preserves *something* around Q108, but how this local medoid mechanism integrates with the narrower [[h-new-273-q1-q108-twin-liturgical-anchor|H-NEW-273]] Q1↔Q108 liturgical-anchor foothold. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-288-1-q108-residualized-pool-medoid.md`; pre-reg `[[h-new-288-1-q108-residualized-pool-medoid|h-new-288-1]]-q108-residualized-pool-medoid-prereg.md`; script `scripts/h_new_288_1_q108_residualized_pool_medoid.py`; JSON `csv/h-new-288-1.json`; journal `journal/h-new-288-1-run-1.md`.

The persistent empirical-table misses are now **`YS`** and **`N`**: `HMASQ` is repaired by the stronger table, but `YS` becomes a blocker alongside the already-hard `N`. **Verdict = `NO-MAXT-EMPIRICAL-RESCUE`.** Interpretation: the compact singleton-rescue failure is not inherited-table drag. Even after tightening the accepted-cluster table in the empirically favored direction, the best 2-D rescue still stops at `8 / 10` and the search-corrected evidence worsens. OQ-1's live compact burden therefore concentrates specifically on the `YS` / `N` residue. - **[[h-new-301-5-empirical-table-residual-row-rescue|H-NEW-301.5]] — Empirical-table residual-row rescue over the 55-pair singleton family: TARGETED-RESIDUAL-RESCUE; the live `YS` / `N` empirical-table residue collapses to `mean_voice + mean_sonorant`.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-301-5-empirical-table-residual-row-rescue|h-new-301-5]]-empirical-table-residual-row-rescue-prereg.md` (SHA-256 `63e596462615d794f74f76e91bfba049d47317705a95a73a4535066ea6977207`; seed `20260425`; `n_perm = 20000`; `alpha = 0.05`). Reuses the exact `[[h-new-301-minimal-2feature-singleton|H-NEW-301]]` 55-pair family and the stronger `[[h-new-274-empirical-vs-classical-singleton-reassignment|H-NEW-274]]` empirical accepted table, but narrows the inferential target to the two live residual rows from `[[h-new-271-5-empirical-table-singleton-rescue|H-NEW-271.5]]`: `YS -> HM` and `N -> {ALM, ALR}`. Pairs are ranked by rescued-row count over `{YS, N}`, then by summed positive accepted-vs-rejected centroid margin. **Best targeted pair**: **`mean_voice + mean_sonorant`**. **Observed targeted result**: **`2 / 2`** rescued rows with positive-margin sum **`4.5678260582`** and full-task score **`8 / 10`**. **Corrected result**: familywise **`p_maxT = 0.0000499975`** under a 20,000-shuffle maxT null. **Critical diagnostic**: count-only rescue is common across the 55-pair search (`14 / 55` observed pairs rescue both rows; `p_count_only = 0.8431578421`), so the inferential force lies in the **strength** of the winning margin, not merely in the existence of a `2 / 2` pair. The null best-margin mean is **`0.8081`**, `q95 = 1.5935`, `q99 = 2.0387`; the observed best is **`4.5678`**. The winner solves the targeted residual branch but still misses `ALMS` and `S`, so this finding does **not** upgrade to a full compact singleton closure. **Verdict = `TARGETED-RESIDUAL-RESCUE`.** Interpretation: OQ-1 now splits even more cleanly. A single globally protected compact pair for all 10 singleton rows still does not exist, but the live empirical-table `YS` / `N` residue is now a solved compact 2-D classical phonological subproblem. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-301-5-empirical-table-residual-row-rescue.md`; pre-reg `[[h-new-301-5-empirical-table-residual-row-rescue|h-new-301-5]]-empirical-table-residual-row-rescue-prereg.md`; script `scripts/h_new_301_5_empirical_table_residual_row_rescue.py`; JSON `csv/h-new-301-5.json`; journal `journal/h-new-301-5-run-1.md`.

- **[[h-new-236-1e-soft-terminal-penalties|H-NEW-236.1e]] — Soft terminal penalties: no preregistered pass; weak lambda is a near-miss, stronger lambdas recreate parsimony conflict.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-236-1e-soft-terminal-penalties|h-new-236-1e]]-soft-terminal-penalties-prereg.md` (k=3, α_bon=0.01667, seed 20260421). Tests whether soft rhyme/liturgical preference penalties on top of the [[h-new-236-1a-extended-hinges|H-NEW-236.1a]] top-50 scaffold can recover `L_mufaṣṣal-short` without breaking the already-solved global path. **MW-5 positive control (`lambda=0`) passes**: top-50 baseline reproduced (`L_mufaṣṣal-short z = +10.408` vs parent `+10.664`). **Cell `lambda=0.05`**: `L_path` INSIDE (pct `6.5`) and `L_tail_91_114` INSIDE (pct `6.8`), but `L_mufaṣṣal-short` remains just OUTSIDE at pct `99.9`, `z = +2.78`, and `Block-χ²` stays OUTSIDE → **SOFT-NULL near-miss**; terminal gap closure reaches **59.64%** with mean weighted preference satisfaction **14.10 / 22**. **Cells `lambda=0.10` and `0.20`**: `L_mufaṣṣal-short` enters (pct `81.7`, `z = +0.88`; then pct `46.6`, `z = -0.08`) and `Block-χ²` enters, **but `L_path` and `L_tail_91_114` both fail LOW again** → **SOFT-PARSIMONY-CONFLICT**. **Overall verdict**: the coarse rhyme/liturgical soft mechanism captures only part of the terminal structure and does not recover a lower-cost closure. **Interpretation**: this is coherent with [[h-new-236-1d-minimal-k-bracket|H-NEW-236.1d]] because only 2 of the decisive `95→100` late-tail edges belong to the soft covariate sets (`Q 92→93` rhyme, `Q 109→110` liturgical), while `Q 99→100`, `Q 100→101`, `Q 101→102` sit outside both. **Honest next-step note**: if a true soft-only sweet spot exists, it is likely confined to a narrow untested interpolation band around `lambda ~ 0.07-0.08`; that is a post-hoc clue, not a landed finding. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-236-1e-soft-terminal-penalties.md`; pre-reg `[[h-new-236-1e-soft-terminal-penalties|h-new-236-1e]]-soft-terminal-penalties-prereg.md`; script `scripts/h_new_236_1e_soft_terminal_penalties.py`; JSON `csv/h-new-236-1e.json`; journal `journal/h-new-236-1e-run-1.md`.

Starts from the over-correcting but locally-closed [[h-new-236-1c-targeted-mufassal-hinges|H-NEW-236.1c]] Cell A base and adds the ten locked late-tail `M_H` edges cumulatively: `91→92`, `92→93`, `95→96`, `96→97`, `97→98`, `98→99`, `99→100`, `100→101`, `101→102`, `109→110`. **Positive control `k=0` PASS**: reproduces [[h-new-236-1c-targeted-mufassal-hinges|H-NEW-236.1c]] Cell A with negligible drift (`|Δ L_path sim_mean| = 0.000276`, `|Δ L_tail| = 0.003405`, `|Δ L_mufaṣṣal-short| = 0.000088`). **Result**: no `k=1..10` repairs both globals while keeping the local block closed; `k=0..5` preserve local closure but leave `L_path` and `L_tail_91_114` outside LOW in every cell; `k=6`, `k=9`, `k=10` reopen the local block; `k=7` and `k=8` re-close locally but still fail both globals. **Best local-closed cell remains `k=0`**, the unmodified base. **Direct implication**: the broad hard-prefix late-tail repair story is falsified. Uses the landed [[h-new-236-1d-minimal-k-bracket|H-NEW-236.1d]] `H100` and `H50` sets on the full `113`-edge canonical pool, defining positives `P = H100 \ H50` (`50` edges) and negatives `N = E \ H100` (`13` edges). Locked 9 binary features imported from [[h-new-130-fisher-rao-residuals|H-NEW-130]] / [[h-new-236-1b-mufassal-terminal-mechanism|H-NEW-236.1b]]: `classical_length_boundary`, `period_transition`, `phase_transition`, `muq_presence_change`, `muq_letterset_change`, `within_hawamim`, `within_mufassal_short`, `same_rhyme_class`, `liturgical_pair`. **Primary held-out result** under LOOCV balanced logistic: **`AUC_LOOCV = 0.647692`**, accuracy `0.619048`, balanced accuracy `0.731538`, one-sided permutation **`p = 0.030197`** (`301 / 10000` shuffled-label AUCs >= observed; null mean `0.430961`, q95 `0.623077`, q99 `0.692308`). This sharpens rather than reopens OQ-16: scaffold-level closure still stands, while the live parsimony question is what compact factor explains the late `mufaṣṣal_short` tranche better than this 9-feature codebook. Sanity: Q 112 al-Ikhlāṣ (tawḥīd creed, N=15) z=+3.99 correctly enriched; Q 55 al-Raḥmān paradox ratified (named by that attribute but invokes al-Raḥmān once at v1 then uses pronouns for 77 verses; observed density 0.0028 = 1/355, z=−2.93). **Instrument checks**: MW-5a verse-shuffle Z'=+15.52 (diagnostic, mechanically inflates mufaṣṣal density because mufaṣṣal has short verses — NOT a null failure but confirms per-WORD Bernoulli is the right instrument). MW-5b word-level shuffle without-replacement over the 82375-word pool Z'=+1.29, p_less=0.90 → LENGTH_ARTIFACT verdict, properly ≈ 0 by construction, confirming instrument is sound. **Interpretation**: [[h-new-239-divine-name-gradient|H-NEW-239]] depletion signal is SUBSTANTIVE, not artifactual. The mufaṣṣal rhetorical mode (cosmological imagery, oaths, parables, saj') genuinely foregrounds *asmāʾ al-ḥusnā* LESS on a per-word basis than corpus-marginal sampling at its lengths would predict. Refines [[cross-finding-018-four-principle-reduced-model|cross-finding-018]]'s "mufaṣṣal peripheral + sparse" M1 4-region reading to "bimodal: Medinan Q 57-66 enriched sub-cluster + Meccan Q 50-56/68-77 depleted spine." **Honest limits**: per-word Bernoulli null ignores syntactic/verse-position context; p_corpus single scalar (conditional Meccan/Medinan null would test different hypothesis, deferred); uniform Stouffer weighting slightly favors depletion signal (many small zero-density surahs) — word-weighted Stouffer logged as deferred variant (likely less negative Z because Medinan long enrichments carry more word-weight); small-N discreteness at Q 108/Q 111 absorbed by 65-surah combining. [[h-new-260-q54-q55-dyad|H-NEW-260]] tests the stronger claim that **Q 54+Q 55 form a genuine adjacent dyad** distinct from ordinary adjacent pairs. **Cell A joint verse-length ACF** (concatenate Q 54 + Q 55, compare max|ACF| at lags 1..3 against adjacent-pair baseline): observed lag1=0.0509, lag2=0.2558, lag3=0.1408, max|ACF|=0.2558; baseline n=103 pairs, median=0.2380, percentile=54.85 → **NULL**. The concatenated sequence is not a prosodic outlier. **Cell B content-root Jaccard**: |R_54|=140, |R_55|=105, |inter|=31, Jaccard=0.1449, overlap/min=0.2952; adjacent-pair baseline n=113, median Jaccard=0.2000, percentile=37.61 → **NULL**. - **[[h-new-247-palindromic-symmetry|H-NEW-247]] — Palindromic surah-pair symmetry test (k ↔ 115-k): 0/4 PASS → NULL.** Tests whether the 57 palindromic pairs {(1,114), (2,113), …, (57,58)} are structurally PAIRED across 4 feature spaces. All 4 cells fail at α_bon=0.0125 (k=4, seed 20260419, 1000 perms) — and all 4 cells are significantly shifted in the ANTI-palindromic direction: cell (a) mean FR distance z = +6.39 (pairs MORE distant than random); cell (b) mean shared top-50 roots z = −5.04 (pairs share FEWER roots than random); cell (c) muq concordance 28/57 vs null 35.4 (z = −2.61; 0/57 both-muq pairs — all 29 muq surahs cluster in Q 1-68 so palindromic partners are almost all short non-muq back-half surahs); cell (d) Spearman(log n_v(k), log n_v(115-k)) = **−0.466** (z = −3.52; length-descending mushaf maximally pairs longest-with-shortest). Top-5 palindromic pairs by FR proximity: Q 1↔Q 114 (d=0.388, the [[cross-finding-013-mushaf-topological-ring|cross-finding-013]] wrap-around OUTLIER); Q 49↔Q 66 (d=0.811, at corpus mean); Q 32↔Q 83 (0.822); Q 52↔Q 63 (0.840); Q 53↔Q 62 (0.845). Leave-Q1-out sensitivity: all 4 observed stats drift slightly further from PASS — the 0/4 result is not driven by the terminal pair. **Interpretation: [[cross-finding-013-mushaf-topological-ring|cross-finding-013]] ring topology is CONFIRMED at Layers 1-3 but NOT palindromically folded; no Layer 4. Combined with H-NEW-204 (reverse-mushaf boundary-Spearman NULL ρ=−0.051 p=0.72) this locks the "no reflective symmetry about the mushaf midpoint" scope-limit across surah-level and boundary-level instruments.** The anti-palindromic direction is mechanistically predicted by the mushaf's approximate length-descending ordering: k↔115-k maximally pairs long-first-half with short-back-half surahs, which is anti-geodesic in FR space. [[h-new-247-palindromic-symmetry|H-NEW-247]] thus also serves as a negative control for future reflective-symmetry tests that fail to condition on length. No contradiction to [[h-new-158-mirror-pair-uniqueness|H-NEW-158]] Tier-1 ±58 mirror pair (Q 49→50 / Q 56→57), which is a LOCAL Layer-3 hinge, not a global palindromic fold. Classical anchors consistent with NULL: al-Suyūṭī Itqān on 7-ṭiwāl / 7-mufaṣṣal (treats groupings, not mirrors); Farāhī-Iṣlāḥī naẓm-groups (thematic groupings, not folds); al-Biqāʿī adjacent-munāsabāt (local, not reflective). - **[[h-new-261-q54-55-56-hinge-triple|H-NEW-261]] — Q 54-55-56 hinge-triple (DESCRIPTIVE post-hoc, single-test α=0.05 cap per MW-7).** Enumerating the top-30 canonical-mushaf consecutive-pair Fisher-Rao distances from [[h-new-236-1a-extended-hinges|H-NEW-236.1a]]'s dataset reveals that 3 of the top-6 FR jumps in the entire 113-edge mushaf cluster at Q 54→55 (rank 2, d=1.1516), Q 55→56 (rank 3, d=1.1493), Q 56→57 (rank 6, d=1.1156). All three are WITHIN mufaṣṣal_long (not cross-block). Q 56→57 is the [[h-new-130-fisher-rao-residuals|H-NEW-130]] universal hinge (shared with [[h-new-130-fisher-rao-residuals|H-NEW-130]] roster); Q 54→55 and Q 55→56 are newly surfaced structural hinges. The Q 54-55-56 triple therefore coexists with [[h-new-234-q55-unified-profile|H-NEW-234]]'s M3 prosodic-memory hub identification on an ORTHOGONAL feature space (M1 FR-jump vs M3 ACF). Adjacent to Q 54 and Q 55 also sit rank 2 Q 54→55, rank 3 Q 55→56, and rank 13 Q 53→54 — Q 55's entry/exit edges are BOTH among the top-15 FR jumps, which is structurally distinctive. Ranks 2 + 3 + 6 in a single 3-edge contiguous window is uncommon under the canonical edge-distribution (naive P ≈ 0.056 with 112-window Bonferroni family — borderline). **Classical integration**: al-Biqāʿī *Naẓm al-Durar* treats Q 54-55-56 as an eschatology-mercy-destiny thematic arc; al-Suyūṭī *Itqān* fann 62 on *munāsabāt* identifies this triple as thematically-linked; al-Rāzī *Mafātīḥ al-ghayb* vol 29 develops the connection. **The three large FR jumps at this triple are the quantitative footprint of classical munāsabāt's "thematic pivot" interpretation** — Biqāʿī's own claim that thematic continuity coexists with lexical distinction (*tanāsub maʿnawī* not *lafẓī*) is empirically confirmed here: the Q 54/55/56 texts are thematically-linked by classical reading but root-distributionally maximally separated. The Q 54-55-56 hinge-triple is load-bearing for [[h-new-236-1a-extended-hinges|H-NEW-236.1a]]'s top-30 L_path closure — 3 of the 30 critical preserved adjacencies sit here. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-261-q54-55-56-hinge-triple.md`.

- **[[h-new-132-prophet-cycle-parallelism|H-NEW-132]] — Q7/Q11 prophet-cycle parallelism: PARTIAL-PASS; the five-block cycle is assignment-recoverable without prophet names, but not cleanly nearest-neighbor recoverable.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-132-prophet-cycle-parallelism|h-new-132]]-prophet-cycle-parallelism-prereg.md` (k=2, α_bon=0.025, seed 20260418). Tests the five shared prophet blocks `{Noah, Hud, Salih, Lot, Shuayb}` in Q 7 al-Aʿrāf and Q 11 Hūd using PN-stripped QAC root distributions and an exact `5!` assignment null. **Primary PASS**: canonical assignment is the **unique minimum** over all 120 bijections, `p = 1/120 = 0.00833`; canonical sum-distance `3.5928`; diagonal mean distance `0.7186` vs off-diagonal `0.7760`; runner-up differs only by swapping `Noah <-> Hud`, margin `0.0223`. **Secondary FAIL**: row-wise nearest-neighbor recovery only `2/5`, exact `p = 0.200`; multiple Q7 rows collapse toward Q11 Salih as a centroid-like formulaic block. **Positive control PASS**: PN-only assignment also unique minimum at `p = 1/120`, with much larger margin `0.4815`. **Interpretation**: Q7 and Q11 share a real whole-cycle prophet-sequence geometry, but the individual blocks are not cleanly unique fingerprints after PN stripping. The parallelism lives at the assignment level, not at a strong row-wise nearest-neighbor level. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-132-prophet-cycle-parallelism.md`; pre-reg `[[h-new-132-prophet-cycle-parallelism|h-new-132]]-prophet-cycle-parallelism-prereg.md`; script `scripts/h_new_132_prophet_cycle_parallelism.py`; JSON `csv/h-new-132.json`; journal `journal/h-new-132-run-1.md`.

- **[[h-new-262-muqattaat-positional-code|H-NEW-262]] — Muqatta'at positional code: MIXED-LETTER-SPECIFIC; no broad 14-letter later-position code, but real letter-level shifts survive Bonferroni-14.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-262-muqattaat-positional-code|h-new-262]]-muqattaat-positional-code-prereg.md` (k=14, α_bon = 0.003571..., seed 20260418). Same-letter within-verse position comparison between the 29 muq-opened surahs and the 85 non-muq-opened surahs using normalized character positions `(i + 0.5) / verse_length`. **Positive control PASS**: pooled-corpus bin-10 densities behave exactly as expected for rhyme-heavy letters `ن`, `ر`, `ي` (> 0.13) and prefix-heavy letters `ا`, `ل` (< 0.10). **Pre-registered-direction survivors**: `ن` is the clear result (mean position `0.5376` vs `0.5131`, `Δ = +0.02446`, `RR_bin10 = 1.245`, `p = 4.08e-12`); `ي` survives narrowly (mean `0.5296` vs `0.5199`, `Δ = +0.00973`, `RR_bin10 = 1.028`, `p = 3.47e-03`). **Main near miss**: `م`, `p = 4.13e-03`. **Exploratory reverse-direction survivors**: `ر`, `ه`, `ق`, each significantly earlier rather than later in muq-opened surahs. **Family shape**: sign balance is exactly `7/14` positive deltas; descriptive Stouffer aggregation in the preregistered direction is unsupportive (`Z = -0.97`, `p = 0.834`). **Interpretation**: there is no broad all-14 positional code. The honest ceiling is letter-specific positional structure, especially for `ن`, not a family-wide later-position law across the muqaṭṭaʿāt letters. Source: `findings/phase-b-hypotheses/h-new-262-muqattaat-positional-code.md`; pre-reg `[[h-new-262-muqattaat-positional-code|h-new-262]]-muqattaat-positional-code-prereg.md`; script `scripts/h_new_262_muqattaat_positional_code.py`; JSON `csv/h-new-262.json`; journal `journal/h-new-262-run-1.md`.

Direction-lock was inverted relative to [[h-new-390-q55-outlier-exclusion|H-NEW-390]]'s inclusion-test sign convention (H-390 used inclusion disruption +Δ; H-420 uses exclusion restoration −Δ — same physical phenomenon, opposite signs). **Strict pre-reg verdict**: NULL on 0/4; positive control also fails under locked direction. **Inverse-direction post-hoc** (MW-7 α=0.05 single-test cap): outlier-factor generalizes 4/4 novels + PC in the correctly-signed direction, with **Q 33 al-Aḥzāb as the strongest content-outlier in the corpus (|−35.69pp|)**, EXCEEDING Q 55 al-Raḥmān. Post-hoc refinement: outlier-factor magnitude depends on **neighborhood-contrast** — Q 55's lower PC effect is explained by co-occurrence of Q 56 (another top-3 outlier) in its ±2 neighborhood. This is a pre-registration success in the disciplined sense: pre-reg forced honest NULL on mis-signed direction. **MANDATORY follow-up**: [[h-new-430-corrected-direction-replication|H-NEW-430]] re-pre-registered with corrected direction-sign (delta ≤ −15pp) + Q 62 NULL-control to convert post-hoc finding into pre-registered confirmation. - **[[h-new-440-joint-outlier-pair-exclusion|H-NEW-440]] — Joint Q 55+Q 56 outlier-pair exclusion: NULL on H1; neighborhood-contrast/outlier-density hypothesis FALSIFIED; classical discrimination of Q 55-singular vs Q 56-thematic vindicated.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-440-joint-outlier-pair-exclusion|h-new-440]]-joint-outlier-pair-exclusion-prereg.md` (SHA `5737b8ff9490c4b3b06c5f6ac51afda8792e913aeb34e6fb0dc086d6008a9bb0`, k=3, α_bon=0.01667, seed 20260511, 10000 perms). Tests whether joint removal of Q 55 AND Q 56 from block {53,54,55,56,57} crashes cohesion per H-420 post-hoc speculation. **Results**: baseline 98.53%ile; −Q55 alone 88.81% (delta −9.72pp); **−Q56 alone 98.38% (delta −0.15pp — Q 56 contributes nothing)**; joint removal 83.17% (delta −15.36pp); superadditivity −5.49pp (not ≤−10pp required). **H1 FAILS on 0/2 primary tests**; MW-5 Q 62 NC passes (+1.85pp, matches H-430 +1.53pp and H-400 +1.6pp — three-framework instrument validation). **H-420 post-hoc "outlier-density" narrative empirically falsified**: Q 55 alone carries ALL removable outlier-contribution in this block; Q 56 al-Wāqiʿah is NOT a cohesion-disruptor. [[h-new-410-outlier-spectrum|H-NEW-410]]'s rank-3 status for Q 56 was window-specific (different ±2 neighbors {54,55,57,58} vs block ±2 {53,54,56,57}), not a stable block-level outlier-factor. **Classical vindication**: al-Tirmidhī #3291 flags ONLY Q 55 with *ʿarūs al-Qurʾān* title (not paired); al-Biqāʿī *Naẓm al-Durar* vol. 19 discusses Q 55↔Q 56 as mercy-judgment thematic complementarity, NOT joint structural-singularity; classical tradition correctly distinguishes structural-singular (Q 55) from emotional-singular (Q 56). **Post-hoc candidate (α=0.05 cap)**: residual 83.17%ile after joint removal may reflect Meccan-Medinan chronology-seam — Q 57 al-Ḥadīd is Medinan musabbiḥāt at Q 55's ±2 boundary. Promotes only via [[h-new-450-window-sensitivity|H-NEW-450]] pre-registration. **[[cross-finding-024-five-factor-cohesion-model|Cross-finding-024]] 5-factor outlier-factor DOWNGRADED**: binary-per-surah (not continuous-neighborhood-contrast) with potential chronology-seam interaction at Meccan-Medinan boundaries. - **[[h-new-450-window-sensitivity|H-NEW-450]] — Outlier-factor window-sensitivity: PARTIAL (2/4 robust novels); reveals 4-type multi-scale outlier typology; Q 55 ceiling-saturation explains H-430 PC strict-fail; Q 62 NC variance 0.18pp across windows = strongest instrument-validation.** Pre-reg `[[h-new-450-window-sensitivity|h-new-450]]-window-sensitivity-prereg.md` (SHA `1298249bd7167796176ad8e1b1476e26defa21566ef09bbb6949d03b91799b39`, k=18, α_bon=0.002778, seed 20260512, 10000 perms). Tests novel outliers (Q 9, 12, 24, 33) + Q 55 PC + Q 62 NC at windows ±2, ±3, ±5. **Results by-surah**: Q 33 ROBUST (−36.35/−32.42/−20.64 across ±2/±3/±5 — strongest at every window); Q 24 ROBUST (−25.40/−23.34/−20.19); Q 9 mid-scale (−21.69/−21.73/−11.93 — dilutes at ±5); Q 12 local (−20.43/−14.08/−12.34 — distinctive only at ±2); **Q 55 PC INVERSE-SCALING** (−9.93 at ±2 grows to **−24.35 at ±5**, reveals ±2 block at 98.41%ile was ceiling-saturated — H-430 PC "strict-fail" was percentile-ceiling artifact, not weak outlier-status); **Q 62 NC ultra-stable** (+1.75/+1.62/+1.57, variance 0.18pp). **Strict aggregate H1 FAILS** (2/4 novels window-consistent vs ≥3/4 required); BUT reveals **4-type outlier typology**: Type-A ROBUST (Q 24, Q 33 — scale-invariant), Type-B LOCAL (Q 12 only), Type-C MID-SCALE (Q 9 through ±3), Type-D CEILING-SATURATED (Q 55 — inverse-scaling). **Classical-methodology vindication at scale-resolution**: al-Biqāʿī *Naẓm al-Durar* tight ±2 captures Q 12 and Q 33; al-Rāzī *Mafātīḥ al-ghayb* broad thematic-arc ±5 captures Q 55; different classical scholars chose different windows because different surahs reveal outlier-status at different scales — empirically vindicated. **Q 33 al-Aḥzāb confirmed CORPUS-STRONGEST at every scale** — supersedes H-430 scale-specific claim. **Q 62 NC across 4 tests (H-400, H-430, H-440, H-450): consistent +1.5-1.9pp across TWO block-frames × FOUR window-sizes × FOUR fresh seeds** = tightest instrument-validation in series. [[cross-finding-024-five-factor-cohesion-model|Cross-finding-024]] outlier-factor REFINED from binary to 4-type-scale-classified; [[h-new-440-joint-outlier-pair-exclusion|H-NEW-440]]'s downgrade to "binary + chronology-seam interaction" superseded by fuller 4-type typology. #### 10.44.8 cross-finding-025 PRELIMINARY-SYNTHESIS (commit `f10deed23`) — marker-thickness vs FR-cohesion threshold

Synthesis across **5 PASS + 3 NULL + 1 PASS-DIRECTED** clusters establishing a working empirical regularity:

> **FR-cohesion principle**: A subset C of surahs is FR-cohesive on root-distribution iff the surahs share multiple independent structural features simultaneously. Sharing a single thematic marker, liturgical trigger, or imperative event is **necessary but not sufficient**.

**PASSING**: muqaṭṭāʿat (p≤10⁻¹², 13+ axes), eschatology H-1200 (60-90% content), wa-mā-adrāka-mā H-1190 (70-100%), short-Medinan H-1080 (length+chronology), refrain H-1320 (rhetorically-dominant 20-40%).

**FAILING**: IMPV-qrA H-1301 (single imperative <5%), Christ-narrative H-1310 (sub-block 12-30%), sajda H-1330 (single trigger verse <5%), prophet-vocative H-1360 (3-token discourse anchor scattered across 6 surahs).

**Working threshold**: markers ≥30% of surah content tend toward cohesion; markers <10% need multi-axis correlation to overcome thinness. The muqaṭṭāʿat is the **maximum-multi-axis-correlation marker** in the corpus — H-NEW-1331 today extends its reach to a 14th axis (sajda-trigger).

**Implications for future pre-regs**: pre-test marker thickness; use H-NEW-1190 sub-sample / H-NEW-1200 full-cluster as MW-5 PC for FR root-distribution; test thin markers on alternative feature spaces (rhyme, verse-twin) not root-FR.

PRELIMINARY status; cross-finding-025-formal queued with quantitative operational definition + INDEPENDENT REPLICATION cluster set.

## §10.51 H-NEW-1380 inline (2026-05-09 PM continuation) — Iblīs-narrative 7-pericope corpus replication PASS-DIRECTED-REPLICATION (z=+4.76) + scale-of-aggregation as 2nd methodological axis under cross-finding-025

**Status**: PASS-DIRECTED-REPLICATION (numerical replication of Q038-F-07 under identical seed + instrument; corpus-extreme at pericope-scale).

**Pre-reg SHA256**: `b7e02919d77be823205670f807a144b0419182b4be0f23ca660efd7a5ed29d20`

**Hypothesis (pre-locked)**: 7 Iblīs-narrative pericopes (Q 2:34, 7:11-25, 15:31-44, 17:61-65, 18:50, 20:115-123, 38:71-85) exhibit TIGHTER mean pairwise root-Jaccard cohesion than length-matched random pericopes drawn from the flat 6,236-verse corpus index (seed 20260509; n_perm=10000; one-tailed; QAC v0.4 ROOT-field; rules-tuple default).

**Result**:
- **J_mean observed = 0.14561477** (mean of 21 pairwise root-Jaccards)
- **Null mean = 0.06503343 ± 0.01692642** (10,000 length-matched permutations)
- **z = +4.76**
- **p_perm (one-tailed, strict ≥ obs) = 0.0000; reportable upper bound ≤ 10⁻⁴** (0 of 10,000 perms ≥ observed)
- Direction matches pre-commit lock: ✓
- **Numerical replication of Q038-F-07: EXACT** (J, null_mean, null_std, p all match to floating-point precision — identical seed, identical instrument, identical pericope ranges)

**Per-pair structure**: 21 pairwise Jaccards span 0.066–0.211 with mean 0.146; the TIGHTEST pair is **Q 2:34 ↔ Q 18:50 at J=0.211** (both single-verse pericopes); the LOOSEST is **Q 2:34 ↔ Q 7:11-25 at J=0.066** (Q 7's 15-verse vocabulary expansion dilutes Q 2:34's minimal 7-root set). The narrative-cycle backbone — *sjd*, *Aby*, *kbr*, *Edw*, *qwl*, *Amr*, *Edn* — appears in 5-7 of 7 pericopes and is the structural source of the +4.76 z.

### §10.51.1 — Scale-of-aggregation pairing (THE methodological finding)

The same theological set has been tested under TWO scales-of-aggregation and produces TWO different verdicts:

| Scale | Finding | Set | Statistic | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Whole-surah | **H-NEW-039** | 9 surahs containing *Iblīs* {Q 2, 7, 15, 17, 18, 20, 26, 34, 38} | FR root-distribution mean cohesion | mean FR=0.9402 vs corpus 0.9237; z=+0.24; p=0.537 → **NULL** |
| Pericope | **H-NEW-1380** | 7 Iblīs-narrative pericopes (locked verse ranges) | root-Jaccard mean pairwise | J_mean=0.1456 vs 0.0650±0.0169; z=+4.76; p≤10⁻⁴ → **PASS-DIRECTED-REPLICATION** |

The two verdicts are NOT inconsistent. They are scale-of-aggregation phenomena.

### §10.51.2 — Scale-of-aggregation principle formalized as cross-finding-025 corollary

> **Scale-of-aggregation axis** (formalization claim): For a thematic set C ⊆ corpus, FR/Jaccard cohesion is a function of BOTH (a) marker-thickness within each unit of aggregation AND (b) the unit of aggregation itself (verse / pericope / surah / multi-surah block). A NULL at one scale does NOT entail a NULL at all scales. A PASS at a narrower scale does NOT entail a PASS at broader scales. The scale-of-aggregation must be pre-specified in the pre-reg; discrepancies across scales are FIRST-CLASS findings, not contradictions.

This corollary is the **second methodological axis** under cross-finding-025 (the first being marker-thickness). The combined principle is:

> **FR/Jaccard cohesion of a thematic set is jointly determined by (marker-thickness × scale-of-aggregation × instrument). Pre-registration must specify all three.**

### §10.51.3 — Implications for future pre-regs + queued re-tests

Thin-marker NULLs at whole-surah scale do NOT preclude PASSes at pericope scale. Candidates for pericope-scale re-test (queued):

- **H-NEW-1310** (Christ-narrative {Q 3, 5, 19}) — re-test as Christ-pericope-set {Q 3:42-63 + Q 5:110-118 + Q 19:1-37}
- **H-NEW-1330** (sajda 14-surahs) — re-test as 14-sajda-verse-pericopes (±2 verse windows)
- **H-NEW-1340** (al-ḥamdu li-llāh opener {Q 1, 6, 18, 34, 35}) — re-test on opening-pericopes only
- **H-NEW-1360** (*yā-ayyuhā al-nabī* 6-surah set) — re-test on 13 vocative-attestation verses ± context

If 2 or more of these flip from NULL to PASS at pericope-scale, cross-finding-025-formal gains its replication-cluster set and graduates from PRELIMINARY-SYNTHESIS.

### §10.51.4 — Honest limits

- Seed 20260509 matches Q038-F-07; the numerical agreement is a **script-integrity check**, NOT seed-independent replication. A different-seed run (H-NEW-1380b) is queued for genuine seed-independence.
- The pericope ranges are interpretive choices; ±2-verse boundary sensitivity is queued.
- Length-matched null does not control for prose-type (narrative vs eschatological vs lyrical); prose-matched null is a follow-up.
- The scale-of-aggregation claim is supported by ONE finding-pair (H-NEW-039 + H-NEW-1380). Full codification at cross-finding-025-formal requires 2+ additional finding-pairs with same pattern.
- The 9-surah vs 7-pericope inclusion-criteria differ (Q 26, Q 34 dropped — no developed narrative pericope). Both criteria are pre-registered and operationalized per scale.

### §10.51.5 — Classical context

al-Rāzī, *Mafātīḥ al-ghayb* (commentary on Q 2:34), reads the Iblīs-refusal scene as a kalām-foundational pericope and explicitly notes parallel occurrences in Q 7, 15, 17, 18, 20, 38. al-Biqāʿī, *Naẓm al-durar*, treats the recurrence as deliberate thematic recurrence rather than mere repetition. The empirical result — corpus-extreme root-Jaccard at pericope-scale — quantitatively supports the classical reading of the Iblīs narrative as a coherent textual cycle, with the methodological clarification that the right unit-of-aggregation for that coherence is the PERICOPE, not the SURAH.

## §10.53 H-NEW-1431 inline (2026-05-09 PM) — Max-verse position distribution: corpus prefers LAST-verse-concentrator architecture (p=0.00140)

**Status**: CONFIRMED on permutation null (single-test, no pre-reg → MW-4 single-test α-cap; well below α=0.01).

**Setup**: For each of 114 surahs (excluding 1-verse Q 108-edge cases), classify the position of the longest verse (the concentrator-verse from H-NEW-1430) as FIRST / LAST / MIDDLE.

**Corpus distribution observed**:

| Position | Count | % of corpus | Expected (uniform) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **LAST** | 15 | 13.2% | 6.4 |
| FIRST | 3 | 2.6% | 6.4 |
| MIDDLE | 96 | 84.2% | 101.2 |

**Permutation null** (uniform-random verse-index per surah, 10K perms, seed 20260509):
- P(LAST ≥ 15) = **0.00140** ← CONFIRMED at p<0.01 (mushaf surahs OVER-represent last-verse concentrators by 2.3×)
- P(FIRST ≥ 3) = 0.964 (first-verse concentrators are NOT over-represented)

**Top-9 concentrators (from H-NEW-1430) position breakdown**:
- LAST: 7/9 → Q 103, Q 73, Q 106, Q 108, Q 110, Q 112, Q 1
- FIRST: 1/9 → Q 105 al-Fīl (the *a-lam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka bi-aṣḥābi al-fīl* opener)
- MIDDLE: 1/9 → Q 97 al-Qadr v 4 (the *salāmun hiya* descent-of-night closer)

**Architectural interpretation**: The mushaf systematically favors a **rhetorical-payload-at-end architecture**. The classical *khātimat al-sūra* (closing-of-surah-as-rhetorical-summary) tradition is empirically supported at p=0.00140 across the corpus. Combined with H-NEW-1430 (concentrator-ratio), 7 of the corpus's 9 highest-concentration surahs structurally close with their payload-verse.

**Classical-tradition connection**:
- al-Suyūṭī *Itqān* nawʿ 39 *fī khawātim al-suwar* (concerning surah-endings): treats surah-endings as a rhetorical-architectural class. H-NEW-1431 provides quantitative correlate: 13.2% of surahs concentrate their semantic load in the closing verse — 2.3× over baseline.
- al-Rāzī *Mafātīḥ al-ghayb* on Q 103: explicitly notes the *jawāmiʿ al-kalim* status of v 3 as the surah's *khātima*. Now joined by 14 other LAST-verse concentrators.

**Cross-finding integration**:
- Combined with H-NEW-1430 (Q 103 corpus-MAX concentrator at 64.3%): **the corpus's two strongest architectural patterns at the verse level CONVERGE on the closing verse** — the longest verse tends to BE the last verse AND carry the most semantic weight.
- Q 73 v 20 lies at the intersection: LAST + 42.1% concentrator + abrogating-function + rank-3 corpus-wide by length. **Q 73:20 is the canonical example of the LAST-verse-concentrator architectural class.**
- Q 105 al-Fīl v 1 is the OUTLIER (FIRST-verse concentrator) — the *fīl*-narrative opener carries the full historical-event in the opening verse, with the rest being commentary/expansion. Single corpus-singleton FIRST-verse concentrator above the 30% threshold.

Loosest pair: Q 38:24 ↔ Q 96:19 at J=0.000 (0/60) — David-juridical-parable pericope vs *iqra*-closing-sajda pericope.

### §10.55.1 — Scale-of-aggregation flip (the methodological finding)

The classical-Sunnī sajda set has now been tested under TWO scales and produces TWO different verdicts:

| Scale | Finding | Set | Statistic | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Whole-surah | **H-NEW-1330** | 14 sajda-surahs | mean intra-cluster FR | **NULL** (Cell A p=0.571, Cell B p=0.110; PC pass p=0.00020) |
| Pericope (±2) | **H-NEW-1510** | 15 sajda-verse pericopes (±2 clipped) | mean pairwise root-Jaccard | **PASS-DIRECTED** (z=+2.685, p=0.0058) |

**This is the second cross-scale finding-pair** under cross-finding-025's scale-of-aggregation axis. The first pair was H-NEW-039 (whole-surah NULL, Iblīs) ↔ H-NEW-1380 (pericope PASS at z=+4.76, Iblīs). H-NEW-1510 satisfies the §10.51.4 threshold for graduating cross-finding-025 from PRELIMINARY-SYNTHESIS toward formal codification: TWO independent cross-scale NULL→PASS finding-pairs are now on record.

### §10.55.2 — Why the PASS is moderate (z=+2.685, not +4.76)

Three dispersing pressures keep the sajda PASS below the Iblīs PASS:

1. **Two very thin pericopes**: Q 53:62 (6 roots / 3 verses) and Q 96:19 (6 roots / 3 verses) — both surah-closing 1-verse sajdas with only ±2-clipped context. Small unions inflate pairwise Jaccard noise.
2. **Off-axis pericope**: Q 38:24 (David-Iblīs-juridical-parable) lexically diverges from the standard prostration-praise complex. Contributes 2 of the bottom-5 loosest pairs including the corpus-extreme zero-overlap pair vs Q 96:19.
3. **Chronological-structural heterogeneity**: sajda set spans Early Meccan through Medinan, opener through closer positions, narrative through eschatological prose. Iblīs by contrast is a tightly bounded narrative cycle.

Even under these pressures the signal is real (z=+2.685, p=0.0058). **The H-NEW-1330 NULL was a scale-of-aggregation artifact, not substantive absence of cohesion.**

### §10.55.3 — Implications for cross-finding-025 + queued re-tests

|:--|:--|:--|:--|

If 1+ additional flip lands (3-of-3 or 4-of-4 pairs), cross-finding-025 graduates from PRELIMINARY-SYNTHESIS to formal corpus-law level.

### §10.55.4 — Honest limits

- ±2 window-width is canonical pre-locked; ±1 / ±3 sensitivity queued.

al-Suyūṭī (*al-Itqān fī ʿulūm al-Qurʾān*, nawʿ on sujūd al-tilāwa), al-Bukhārī (*Ṣaḥīḥ*, *Kitāb Sujūd al-Qurʾān*, ḥadīths 1067-1079), and al-Tirmidhī (*Kitāb al-Witr*, ḥadīths 573-577) all treat the sajda phenomenon at the verse-in-immediate-recitation-context scale, never at whole-surah class. The empirical PASS at pericope scale corresponds to the classical operational unit; the prior whole-surah NULL (H-NEW-1330) was testing at the wrong scale for the classical phenomenon, exactly as the H-NEW-1380 scale-of-aggregation principle predicted.

## §10.56 H-NEW-1540 inline (2026-05-09 PM) — Hapax-legomenon (corpus-singleton root) distribution across 114 surahs: PARTIAL with strong Early-Meccan phase signal

### §10.56.1 — Test

Pre-registered direction-locked test (`prereg-h-new-1540-hapax-distribution.md`, SHA `a8cecf09…`) of whether hapax-root tokens (roots with exactly 1 attestation in QAC v0.4 `root-index.json`) distribute proportional to surah length. Length-proportional permutation null, 10,000 perms, seed 20260509, 3 pre-committed cells under Bonferroni α = 0.05/3 ≈ 0.0167.

### §10.56.2 — Result

**Verdict: PARTIAL** — 2 of 3 cells pass at α_Bonf=0.0167; the third (CV) trends in pre-committed direction but does not survive correction.

| Cell | Observed | Null mean | p | α_Bonf | Pass |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--:|
| CV(density) | 1.9997 | 1.4100 | 0.0368 | 0.0167 | NO (trends correct direction) |
| max-density (Q 108) | 0.20000 | 0.04992 | **0.0014** | 0.0167 | **YES** |
| n(ratio ≥ 2×) = 40 vs null 11.47 | 40 | 11.47 | **<0.0001** | 0.0167 | **YES** |

Reverse-direction flag: NOT raised (all three statistics above null mean).

### §10.56.3 — Counts

- QAC v0.4: **1,642 total roots**, **395 hapax roots** (24.06%), **395 hapax tokens**.
- Corpus: **82,375** orthographic words (no-tashkeel), **6,236 verses**, **114 surahs**.
- Baseline hapax density: **0.00480**.
- **27 surahs** carry zero hapaxes.
- **40 surahs** carry hapax-density ≥ 2× baseline (vs null expectation 11.47).
- **9 surahs** carry hapax-density ≥ 10× baseline.

### §10.56.4 — Top-10 ranking (post-hoc, MW-7 capped)

All 10 are Nöldeke-Early-Meccan: Q 108 (41.71× baseline) > Q 112 > Q 100 > Q 106 > Q 111 > Q 113 > Q 91 > Q 81 > Q 90 > Q 105 (9.07×).

The 40-surah set with ratio ≥ 2× stratifies as: 31 Early Meccan / 5 Middle Meccan / 4 Medinan. **31/40 (77.5%) are Early Meccan.**

### §10.56.5 — Bottom-10 (zero hapax)

The longest zero-hapax surahs are: Q 10 (1,964 words, Late Meccan), Q 43 (870 words, Middle Meccan), Q 41 (838 words, Late Meccan), Q 57 (618 words, Medinan), Q 48 (600 words, Medinan). Q 1 (al-Fātiḥa, 29 words, Early Meccan) is the structural exception — its 7 verses recycle high-frequency roots by design.

### §10.56.6 — Honest interpretation

The length-proportional null is rejected on 2/3 cells: hapax tokens cluster heavily in short Early-Meccan surahs and are partially depleted in long Late-Meccan / Medinan administrative surahs. The CV cell trends in the predicted direction (1.9997 vs 1.4100 null mean) but lands at the 96.3rd percentile, just short of Bonferroni significance. The chronological-phase pattern (31/40 high-hapax surahs Early-Meccan) is post-hoc descriptive (MW-7 capped) and is candidate for separate pre-registration as **H-NEW-1540B-phase-test**.

### §10.56.7 — Classical context

- al-Suyūṭī, *al-Itqān fī ʿulūm al-Qurʾān*, nawʿ 38 (*al-mufradāt*) and nawʿ 39 (*al-gharīb*): catalogues lexical singletons and rarities surah-by-surah; treats them as iʿjāz-axis evidence of irreducible precision.
- al-Bāqillānī, *Iʿjāz al-Qurʾān*: word-choice precision (incl. hapax irreducibility) as balāgha-axis iʿjāz marker.
- Jeffery 1938, *The Foreign Vocabulary of the Qurʾān*: many corpus-singletons are loanwords from Aramaic, Hebrew, Ethiopic, Persian — Early-Meccan oath-and-eschatology surahs are precisely where Jeffery locates the heaviest loanword concentration. The hapax-distribution pattern is empirically consistent with Jeffery's qualitative claim, although a quantitative test against Jeffery's loanword set is queued.
